store_data.about_the_game:
I'm not sure how it happened. I woke up on a morning like any other.

I didn't die, didn't get into an accident and float out of a wreck. One morning I woke up, and my body was gone. I was out of body, and that was it.

……

I always thought I'd get married and have kids someday. Family man, just like the folks wanted (just like my brother). I guess "someday" never really became "today" - it always felt a few more years out, just a few more years out.

And so, I had an apartment in the city, a freelance career, and not too many people have come looking since I've disappeared. I guess that is why I'm looking for a new body.

Out of Body is a picturesque point-and-click adventure reminiscent of classics such as Day of the Tentacle, Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis, Monkey Island, as well as modern entries like Gemini Rue and Kentucky Route Zero.

From the scope of the story, to the puzzle designs, characters, and dream-like sequences, OoB will build off what made the genre great back in the day and give a new generation an opportunity to experience a tale of their own.

Out of Body Act I is in progress for a release on PC/Mac/Switch, followed by a joint release of Acts II & III thereafter.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Cipitio and the Cuscatlecan Legends is a retro game with 16-bit pixel art style. It is a TOP-DOWN TWIN-STICK SHOOTER, a 2D shooting game with a top-down perspective that combines retro mechanics with a story inspired by Salvadoran folklore.

In this world, El Cipitio, son of La Siguanaba, is trapped in an ancient curse. La Siguanaba, punished by the god Tlaloc for deceiving her husband, was condemned to become a terrifying apparition that frightens men near rivers and streams. As a consequence of this punishment, her son, El Cipitio, was transformed into an immortal goblin who never ages or dies. Though mischievous and playful, El Cipitio feels tormented by eternity, and in his despair, he decides to turn himself into stone to escape the endless loneliness.

During the two thousand years that El Cipitio remains asleep, humanity nearly becomes extinct after a great war. The survivors adopt pre-Columbian cultures as their religion and, through the technology of the ancient gods, manage to channel their power. However, human greed leads them to create monstrous creatures to fight among themselves, provoking the wrath of the gods, who eventually abandon the Earth, leaving their technological advances behind.

Taking advantage of the chaos, a dark sorcerer, a malevolent entity that has existed since ancient times, begins to plot a plan to seize this ancestral power. Recruiting mythological beings from Salvadoran folklore—such as La Chancha, El Padre Sin Cabeza, La Descarnada, El Justo Juez de la Noche, and even La Siguanaba herself—the sorcerer gathers an army of dark creatures.

Faced with this threat, the god Tlaloc decides to awaken El Cipitio, giving him the mission to stop the dark sorcerer. To aid him, Tlaloc grants him the manifestation of his warrior spirit, Ixtli, who together with the Cadejo Blanco will accompany El Cipitio on his epic adventure to save the world.

store_data.about_the_game:
Form Your Squad

Purchase units in the unit shop to form your squad. Each unit comes with a unique skill. If multiple units with the same bond are on the field, you can also unlock exclusive bond skills.

Draw Number Resolution

Draw a random number. The grid with the matching number on the board will light up, and the unit placed on that grid will activate its skill. Some skills grant attack value, multiplier bonus, and attack count. The higher these values, the more damage you deal to the boss.

Purchase Treasures

Treasures come with a variety of skill effects to help your squad take on the boss with ease.

Unit Upgrade

Units have a total of 3 tiers. Unit level is extremely important — the higher the tier, the more powerful its own skill becomes. However, unit tier does not affect bond skills in any way.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Cinder Throne is an Idler RPG where you fight enemies by waiting, customize your equipment and build to fit your playstyle and tackle harder and harder challenges.

Game Loop

Automatically fight enemies and loot them, explore various zones until you kill the final boss, upgrade yourself and try harder zones or difficulties (difficulties are personalizable), then repeat.

Loot

Enemies will drop loot that you can equip in 6-12 slots, each item will give different stats and they can be enchanted, enchanted items will give less stats but have spells attached to them.
Spells will synergize with your own stats and upgrades.

Upgrades

After a run, upgrade yourself in multiple Upgrade Trees, these trees will have various bonuses from small stat buffs to synergistic buffs, to powerfull buffs that add new mechanics to your character.
Some Paths will lock others, so you have to personalize your build and try to make synergies to be as powerfull as possible.

store_data.about_the_game:
Reese is a man who is uncomfortable with himself and his life. He finds escapism by reading yuri (F/F) stories on his laptop. One day while riding the subway, Lucy the witch sidles up next to him. Seeing an opportunity for mischief, she transforms Reese into a woman so he can “enjoy” this yuri content he so desperately craves—but in real-life!

Unfortunately for Lucy, Reese is ecstatic at this. Even worse, she realizes that the newly-elated Reese makes a pretty cute woman. And when Reese suddenly asks her to go shopping, Lucy can’t refuse – after all, what if Reese does something nefarious in her new body?

Genre: Yuri, Romance, Kinetic Visual Novel

Length: Around 10k words (about an hour)

Language: English

Content Warnings: Foul language, alcohol, gender dysphoria & euphoria, moths

Characters

As a man, Reese is quiet, muted, and believe he wants a relationship like the yuri stories that he reads. Reese is trying to fit a mold that he is not.

Once transformed, Reese is boisterous, happy, and willing to stand up for herself and those she cares about.

A recent graduate from Magic Caster's University, Lucy is a mischievous witch who wants to find her place in the world. When Reese enjoys being the victim of one of her curses, Lucy's reality is thrown askew.

store_data.about_the_game:
Surviving the night as a kid was always tough. If you had a nightmare, it was hard to go back to sleep. If you heard a noise, you would start to come up with the most irrational reason for the sound. However, in this case, your theories may seem less far out.

store_data.about_the_game:
Hibera, Requiem for the Forgotten is an SRPG about two bands of friends and warriors struggling to survive on opposing sides of a continent-spanning war. Embark on a lengthy campaign of strategic battles where every choice could be your last. Pixel graphics and classic aesthetics hearken back to a bygone era of games when larger-than-life myths were told on tiny screens.

CAMPAIGN & STORY

The year is 1394. The year is 806. The year is 153. The Tri-Kingdom Alliance of Atha, Lundale, and Cathebria maintain an uneasy hold over the rich pastureland and deep mines of Hibera. The alliance is a fractious and unstable agreement, born of necessity and endured with ill-grace. It holds only because of the intrusions of Quiretia, the empire beyond the waves.

Maebh has grown up living hard on the streets of Tinbher. When her brother Diarmuid is caught stealing from a wealthy Tinbher noble, she makes a deal. In exchange for not turning him over to the authorities, Maebh is tasked with hunting down a valuable relic. She must rally those she can trust to make the journey north.

Alto is an enlisted man in the Quiretian army. He has found himself far from home and entrenched in a protracted siege of Carraig Donn. A stroke of luck puts him in the right place at the pivotal moment as the city falls, and he finds himself in command for the first time in his life. He must shoulder the burden of the lives of his comrades as the army marches east.

As the darkness of war spreads across the land, Alto and Maebh will find their strength, skill and conviction tested. There is no space for neutrality as the great powers of the world collide, and they cannot afford to be mere pawns. They will have to decide what they want to protect and what they can bear to sacrifice. And beneath them, something long buried is stirring in the dark, something that will force them to confront the very worst and best of themselves...

TACTICAL COMBAT

Hibera, Requiem for the Forgotten uses turn-based grid combat with weapon triangle mechanics. Build your warband from scratch, recruit allies, manage limited equipment, and adapt to enemy strategies. Permadeath means every move matters.

  • Weapon Triangle: The classic Rock-Paper-Scissors mechanic, fully realized with modern additions.

  • Deep Roster: Each playable character has their own story, strengths, weaknesses, and relationships.

  • Vast Armory: An eclectic collection of weapons, spells, abilities and consumables allow for deep customization.

  • Fog of War & Terrain: Strategic depth through vision and environmental bonuses set in a gorgeous 2.5D landscape

The game takes strong inspiration from the Fire Emblem school of SRPGs particularly the GBA era games like Blazing Blade and Sacred Stones. Fans of that era of game will feel right at home. That doesn't mean Hibera is a simple carbon copy of those titles, of course.

The game is set in a fantasy world undergoing a renaissance so we see military technology similar to the 15th century in Europe. It is a particularly exciting period of history because a lot of different military technologies are all viable at the same time, and Hibera takes this to heart.  The classic swords, and spears are joined by poleaxes, crossbows, and even arquebuses and grenados.

Magic has also gotten a boost with a fully realized weapon triangle of it's own and a wider variety of magic users.  On top of that there's a much stronger emphasis on non-combat magic. Not just healing, but buffs and debuffs are first class citizens of the magic world.

There's also a greater focus on the use of consumable items. Each unit can take 2 single-use items with them into battle, which means you'll have to use them wisely, but they'll restock before your next mission so you might as well use 'em.  In addition to healing potions, there's elixirs, grenados, and much more.

It's been over 20 years since those original titles sparked our inspiration, and with the power of hindsight, there's a lot of quality of life improvements that we've brought to the classic formula.  Weapon durability is a thing of the past! Special promotion items are gone by the wayside!

When war comes to your door, when the claws of long-buried history reach out to drag you into darkness, what will you risk and what will you sacrifice? Can you find a path through violence and despair to save yourself, your friends, your people, and the world itself?

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome back, Keepers. 

Burn away the fog to build a dungeon fit for all manner of the undead. Bait the corrupted humans and their unwitting creations into clever traps and your waiting minions. Harvest their remains or relieve them of their broken mental state through emprisoning and treatment. Create a sprawling dungeon like colony to tend to your creatures needs, and watch as they research, fight, and devour biblically accurate chickens.

Burn the fog - the map must first be carved out by your summoned shades. This clears space to build rooms, place traps, and summon minions.

Conjure rooms - each minion has their own needs and desires. Build the rooms that they will want, and the dungeon heart will bring them forth to do your bidding.

Minion AI - you have no direct control over your creatures. Though smarter than a biblically accurate chicken, these undead mostly take suggestions to follow. Mark a target, give them tasks, and they will get it done - in their own time.

Cast spells and place traps - the direct intervention of the hand. Heal your minions, doom your foes, and place cunning taps to slow the ingress of the corrupted knocking at your doors. 

Ultimately, heal the minds and actions of the land you have been tasked. Imprison your enemies and cure their bodies. It is not just the fog that must be burnt - it is the tainted hearts of man itself.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the world of Elysara, an ancient artifact called the Heart of the Limiar has awakened — and seven divine sisters are racing to claim its power.

You are Valkyria, the youngest of seven daughters of the Goddess of the Limiar. When the Heart's pulse spread across the land, granting the power to grow through magical prowess, all seven sisters had the same thought: mine.

Armed with two orbiting orbs, Valkyria sets out across six elemental territories — each controlled by one of her sisters — to break their seals and claim the Flow for herself.

Twin-Stick Combat, Dual Orb Control

Command two orbs simultaneously — one with each analog stick. Each orb fires independently, creating a dual-threat that forces enemies to split their attention. Master the art of positioning both orbs to overwhelm your foes.

Resonance System

Keep your orbs close together to activate Resonance — a proximity-based power boost that increases fire rate, damage, and range. Balance risk and reward: cluster for power, or spread for coverage.

Link Beam

A beam of energy connects your two orbs, dealing continuous damage to any enemy caught between them. Use positioning as a weapon.

7 Sisters

Journey through diverse environments, each guarded by a powerful sister boss:

  • Enchanted Forest — Verdânia, keeper of growth

  • Crystal Cavern — Azúria, mistress of shadows

  • Underwater Cave — Marélia, ruler of the depths

  • Desert Ruins — Sahira, dancer of storms

  • Lava Chamber — Ignária, wielder of fire

  • Mystic Portal — Aurorá, guardian of the Seal

Upgrade Your Orbs

After each boss victory, choose from powerful upgrades:

  • Ricochet — bullets bounce between enemies

  • Pierce — shots pass through multiple targets

  • Chain Lightning — arcs of electricity jump to nearby foes

  • Area Damage — explosive impact zones

  • Regeneration, Vampirism, and more

Side Stories

Unlock character stories for each sister after defeating them. Discover their motivations, rivalries, and the family dynamics behind the conflict.

Mother Challenge

A 20-minute survival mode unlocked after completing the main story. Endure endless waves with all your upgrades active. How long can you last?

CG Gallery

Unlock beautiful CG illustrations by completing the story, watching all Side Stories, and conquering the Mother Challenge.

10 Languages

Fully translated in: Português (BR), English, Español, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文, 繁體中文.

Full Controller Support

Designed for dual-analog controllers. Keyboard & mouse also supported.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Black Fleet hunts you. Your Flagship must survive. You must go into the maw of the Dread Admiral's fleets.

Dread Admiral is a turn-based naval roguelite where you command a persistent fleet across a hostile archipelago. Every ship you build carries forward and every ship you lose is lost forever. Every turn you spend on a mission is a turn less for the future - and a turn closer to a relentless enemy engulfing you. 

Persistent Progression

Earn ranks, unlock Perks and technology, and earn upgrades for your Flagship even when you lose.

Escalating pressure

Every turn the Black Fleet gets closer - will you gather more resources and ships or will you abandon your mission to buy time?

Adaptive Warfare

No two campaigns play the same. Navigate unpredictable mission modifiers against AI Admirals with distinct personalities and tactics, deciding when you fight and when you flee.

Tactical Depth

Alternating Activations - You're always looking for the next best move, as is your opponent. Every ship has been delicately balanced to have a role to play.

Why play Dread Admiral?

Dread Admiral is perfect for players who enjoyed FTL, Urtuk: The Desolation, or Darkest Dungeon. You will lose. You will make tough decisions. You will run out of time. You will fail mission objectives. You will eke out victory by the slimmest of margins against an AI that adapts its fleet and economy to yours.

store_data.about_the_game:
Make your way through the grid, solving word mazes and jigsaw puzzles. The words will lead you through a surreal, liminal space and require the collection of puzzle pieces to unlock the path forward. The atmosphere is chill, and relaxed, involving walking, jumping, and flying mechanics.

At the heart of the game is a poetic verse, attempting to explain what it has found within the grid.

Features:

With over 120 modest sized rooms with about 80 mazes and 24 puzzles, expect at least 8 hours of play.

Controls:

The game can be played with either a Keyboard & Mouse, or a Gamepad.

All controls can be customized, including an inverted Y axis option.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are one of the lucky adventurers who made it alive to the cursed land of Kopno.

Armed with your might and a powerful artefact, you must carve a place for yourself in a world that does not wait for you.

In Kopno, every creature lives by its own needs, fears, and ambitions.

People eat, rest, grow greedy, seek safety — or power. Injured bandits don’t magically recover without supplies. Ghoul scouts roam endlessly to build new nests. The world moves forward with or without you.

You are not the center of this world.

You must earn your place in it.

Play as one of 6 distinct races, each with two ethnicities, from ruthless Orcs to cunning Goblins and resilient Humans.

Your race influences your gameplay, culture, and the way the world reacts to you.

Forge your identity and decide what kind of legend you will become.

Kopno is built on two interconnected layers:

  • The Surface

  • The Underground

Each layer contains 4 unique biomes, demanding different gear, preparation, and strategies to survive. Exploration is not optional — it’s essential.

Adapt, or perish.

Create a thriving settlement in a hostile land.

  • Recruit settlers with traits and families.

  • Assign jobs: gathering, crafting, military, logistics, and more.

  • Automate production chains.

  • Appoint leadership roles to shape your society’s future.

Your settlement is more than a base — it is a living community shaped by your decisions.

Discover companions with:

  • Unique quests

  • Distinct personalities

  • Specialized combat mechanics

Their loyalty is not guaranteed.

Your moral choices and leadership will determine who stands beside you — and who walks away.

Choose from 40 different classes and combine skills to create your own combat style.

Command your companions using customizable behavior systems:

  • Target weak or elite enemies

  • Auto-heal and react to your abilities

  • Execute defined tactical roles

Combat is not mindless hacking and slashing — it is preparation, positioning, and adaptation.

Study your opponents.

Destroying specific body parts can disable abilities, trigger new behaviors, or shift the flow of battle.

But be warned — your own injuries affect gameplay as well.

Every fight has consequences.

Be lawful. Be chaotic. Be merciful. Be ruthless.

Your choices influence:

  • Companion loyalty

  • Settlement stability

  • The political balance of the continent

Will you lead your people to prosperity — or sacrifice everything for power?

Survival in Kopno is not just about gathering resources and building walls.

Explore ancient dungeons.

Uncover the secrets of a lost civilization.

Shape the final fate of every race on the cursed continent.

The endgame will determine what Kopno becomes.

Experience Kopno your way.

Embark on a fully playable single-player adventure, bringing up to 3 NPC companions with you into the wild.

Or invite your friends to:

  • Explore the continent together

  • Build and expand your settlement

  • Conquer bosses and dungeons

There are no forced multiplayer servers.

Choose from flexible online options that let you decide how and when to play.

Your world. Your rules.

store_data.about_the_game:
Spooky’s Playground is a throwback to Arcade HighScore games; set in a colorful, cartooney sandbox. Your goal is simple: complete all objectives as fast as possible; getting faster each time you do it.

Dash through different levels with unique settings, using physics, your creativity and the environment to your advantage. Every strategy can be a shortcut, every mistake costs time, and every quest is a chance to optimize your route.

Do It, Do It Again, Do It Faster!

Experiment, discover faster strategies, and express yourself through speed and precision. With our Global and Friend Leaderboards, Spooky’s Playground is all about being faster than everyone else, even yourself.

Our Scoring system takes into account all of the objectives you complete, and how fast you complete them.

Remember, Speed is always Key!

A Throwback to the Golden Era of Gaming!

Find all of the secrets hidden within our levels, for a chance to score higher than your friends. Curious players are rewarded for their out-of-the-box thinking!

This game was born from our love of fast-paced arcade classics, so we understand how much it matters to pour detail and love into our creation.

We urge you to look for all hidden objectives!

Make your way through the levels without being caught!

NPC's can't see you, but they can surely see things flying in front of them! Don't get caught, as you'll end your run on the spot!

Key Features

  • Replayability: levels designed to be replayed and optimized

  • Physics-driven gameplay: Grab everything you can see and find interesting ways to solve puzzles

  • Multiple Levels: different settings allow for maximum chaos

store_data.detailed_description:
Spooky’s Playground is a throwback to Arcade HighScore games; set in a colorful, cartooney sandbox. Your goal is simple: complete all objectives as fast as possible; getting faster each time you do it.

Dash through different levels with unique settings, using physics, your creativity and the environment to your advantage. Every strategy can be a shortcut, every mistake costs time, and every quest is a chance to optimize your route.

Do It, Do It Again, Do It Faster!

Experiment, discover faster strategies, and express yourself through speed and precision. With our Global and Friend Leaderboards, Spooky’s Playground is all about being faster than everyone else, even yourself.

Our Scoring system takes into account all of the objectives you complete, and how fast you complete them.

Remember, Speed is always Key!

A Throwback to the Golden Era of Gaming!

Find all of the secrets hidden within our levels, for a chance to score higher than your friends. Curious players are rewarded for their out-of-the-box thinking!

This game was born from our love of fast-paced arcade classics, so we understand how much it matters to pour detail and love into our creation.

We urge you to look for all hidden objectives!

Make your way through the levels without being caught!

NPC's can't see you, but they can surely see things flying in front of them! Don't get caught, as you'll end your run on the spot!

Key Features

  • Replayability: levels designed to be replayed and optimized

  • Physics-driven gameplay: Grab everything you can see and find interesting ways to solve puzzles

  • Multiple Levels: different settings allow for maximum chaos

  • Fast restarts: Don't get slowed down by boring loading screens and unskippable cutscenes

  • Controller support on PC: play with your preferred input

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a realistic life simulation game focusing on the career of an individual software developer.

There are no set paths. Whether to focus on becoming an expert developer admired by the community, work in potential unicorn startups to get rich, or try to have a calm life just waiting for retirement, it's all up to your own choices.

Your Own Journey

  • Your character starts their journey as a young adult. You will be by their side for many in-game years.

  • The game ends when you complete the major goal of the different paths that can be taken (e.g. become a millionaire, get enough expertise as developer to be considered an industry leader, survive until retirement)

  • You will decide the direction of their career: go to college or not, learn new skills with online content or rely on your initial knowledge, work overtime or try to have more free time...

  • You can lose if your character reaches critical levels in certain aspects of their life (e.g. burnout, buried in debt, unhealthy habits)

Money

  • At the beginning, your character will be still living with their parents, so rent will be free. But expect to pay rent for your own apartment sooner or later, depending of your actions.

  • You can purchase better furniture for your room (e.g. PCs, consoles...), but be careful with your expenses to avoid getting in debt.

  • When you find a job, your employer will pay you every two in-game weeks. Manage your paychecks carefully.

Grow as a Software Developer

  • You can start your journey by getting into college, or jump straight to work after completing a bootcamp.

  • After that, you will be able to level-up your skills with online courses.

  • Leveling-up your character involves answering real-world software engineering questions. Try to answer them correctly and your character will grow quicker!

store_data.about_the_game:
Lisa wakes up in a dark dungeon with no memory of who she is or how she got there.

Strange monsters roam the halls, forgotten ruins hide dangerous secrets, and the only way forward is to fight, survive, and recover the memories she has lost.

In this story-driven adventure, every decision you make shapes Lisa’s journey. The choices you take during conversations, battles, and critical moments will determine how her story unfolds.

Will you uncover the truth behind Lisa’s past, or will the dungeon consume her before she remembers who she really is?

Gameplay

Lisa: The Lost Memories is a story-driven adventure game with visual novel elements, dungeon exploration, and action-based encounters.

  • Explore mysterious dungeon environments filled with monsters, hidden paths, and fragments of Lisa’s memories.

  • Fight enemies through interactive encounters and quick-time combat moments.

  • Make dialogue choices that influence relationships, events, and the direction of the story.

  • Unlock pieces of Lisa’s past as you progress deeper into the dungeon.

  • Discover multiple story outcomes depending on the decisions you make.

The game blends narrative storytelling with interactive gameplay, combining dialogue choices, cinematic sequences, and intense encounters as Lisa searches for the truth about her lost memories.

Features

  • Multiple Endings

    Your choices matter. Every decision you make will shape Lisa’s journey and determine how her story unfolds. Discover different endings depending on the paths you take and the secrets you uncover.

  • Quick-time Events

    Stay alert during intense moments. React quickly during combat and critical scenes. Your timing and reflexes can determine whether Lisa survives dangerous encounters in the dungeon.

  • Cinematic Cutscenes

    Experience key story moments through cinematic cutscenes that reveal Lisa’s memories, emotions, and the mysteries hidden inside the dungeon.

Each playthrough can reveal new choices, new events, and different pieces of the mystery waiting to be uncovered.

store_data.about_the_game:
In a dark digital world, geometric signals have lost their balance. Your mission: restore symmetry.

SYMETRIA is a puzzle game where you draw lines on a grid to reproduce geometric transformations. Start simple, then face increasingly complex patterns as you progress through five distinct modes:

Five Transformation Modes

  • Axial Symmetry — Mirror shapes across a vertical axis
  • Central Symmetry — Rotate patterns 180° around a center point
  • Translation — Shift shapes along a vector
  • Rotation — Rotate patterns by precise angles (90°, 60°, 45°...)
  • Homothety — Scale shapes from a center point

150 Levels

30 levels per mode, across three difficulty tiers:
  • Basic — Simple shapes to learn the rules
  • Intermediate — Multi-segment figures that test your precision
  • Advanced — Complex patterns that challenge your spatial reasoning

Features

  • Clean, minimalist cyberpunk aesthetic
  • Ambient electronic soundtrack
  • Star rating based on accuracy — aim for a perfect run with zero mistakes
  • No time pressure — think, draw, solve at your own pace
  • Accessible yet deep — easy to pick up, satisfying to master

store_data.about_the_game:
Heavy iron doors separate my little world from the cold hallway. It's always so unsettling there.

DONT OPEN is a PSX-style horror game about routine that falls apart before your eyes. A normal shift at a taco bar, an empty stairwell, and a persistent knock on the door that's impossible to ignore. Based on real events.

HOME IS YOUR FORTRESS. UNTIL YOU LOOK THROUGH THE PEEPHOLE. Your life is a cycle. The day begins in a noisy cafe where you prepare tacos and pour Coke for an endless stream of customers. You spend your evenings in an old apartment, surrounded by dusty belongings and “dead trees on canvas.” But today, your usual routine will be disrupted. DON'T OPEN is a brief immersion into a state of paranoia. There are no monsters or weapons here. There is only you, your neighbors, and a growing sense of fear behind the front door.

FEATURES: Life as it is: from work shifts to mundane household chores — feel the weight of everyday routine. Disturbing neighbors: chance encounters in the hallway. A strange old man or a neighbor suddenly running out of their apartment — who poses a real threat? Hypnotist: a surreal, hypnotic event that will make you question reality right in your living room. 90s aesthetics: low-poly environments and shaky textures recreate the authentic spirit of classic horror. Sound as the enemy: knocks on the door, footsteps in the hallway, and TV interference replace the traditional soundtrack.
store_data.detailed_description:
Heavy iron doors separate my little world from the cold hallway. It's always so unsettling there.

DONT OPEN is a PSX-style horror game about routine that falls apart before your eyes. A normal shift at a taco bar, an empty stairwell, and a persistent knock on the door that's impossible to ignore. Based on real events.

HOME IS YOUR FORTRESS. UNTIL YOU LOOK THROUGH THE PEEPHOLE. Your life is a cycle. The day begins in a noisy cafe where you prepare tacos and pour Coke for an endless stream of customers. You spend your evenings in an old apartment, surrounded by dusty belongings and “dead trees on canvas.” But today, your usual routine will be disrupted. DON'T OPEN is a brief immersion into a state of paranoia. There are no monsters or weapons here. There is only you, your neighbors, and a growing sense of fear behind the front door.

FEATURES: Life as it is: from work shifts to mundane household chores — feel the weight of everyday routine. Disturbing neighbors: chance encounters in the hallway. A strange old man or a neighbor suddenly running out of their apartment — who poses a real threat? Hypnotist: a surreal, hypnotic event that will make you question reality right in your living room. 90s aesthetics: low-poly environments and shaky textures recreate the authentic spirit of classic horror. Sound as the enemy: knocks on the door, footsteps in the hallway, and TV interference replace the traditional soundtrack.

Those Who Stayed is a first-person psychological horror game set across three nights in a suburban neighborhood that something decided to keep. Read what residents left behind. Piece together why they ran. Understand why some of them couldn’t.

There’s no combat. There’s nowhere to fight back.

There’s only the street, the dark between the lamps, and the growing certainty that you already know how this ends.

60 minutes. One neighborhood. No one stays.

The Gameplay

This game is primarily a first-person narrative walking simulator with exploration, discovery, and environmental storytelling mechanics.

Key Features

  • 60-minute focused horror experience

  • Atmospheric environment and photorealistic graphics

  • Three nights of escalating psychological terror

  • Environmental storytelling through documents and objects

  • No combat

  • Tension through atmosphere

  • Full controller support

  • Play soccer

store_data.about_the_game:
Watsonville is a first-person psychological horror VR game.

It places players in the role of a child navigating the traumatic aftermath of a violent argument between their parents inside a cramped 1990s family trailer. After hiding under the bed during the conflict, you must discover what happened and find a way to escape the house and its past.

Players explore a mobile home and its surrounding spaces, interacting with objects and solving environmental puzzles that reveal pieces of a family's story. As you move through the house, everyday rooms begin to shift and distort through the lens of childhood fear, turning familiar spaces increasingly surreal as reality blends with nightmare.

Can you escape your family's dark past before it consumes you?

Environment

The game takes place in a multigenerational family mobile home. Your grandparents once lived here, and now you have inherited it along with its lingering secrets. From a child’s perspective everything feels larger, more confusing, and more intense.

The walls and rooms are filled with decorations and belongings from the 1970s through the 1990s, reflecting the life of a working-class family across generations. Players must crawl, climb, and duck through these spaces to uncover the memories, ghosts, and secrets hidden within the rooms and something else that lingers in the shadows.

Story

Not only have your parents left you alone in your grandparents’ trailer, they have left you with the weight of generations of unresolved trauma. Each room reveals another piece of the story, fragments of neglect, fear, and memory that continue to echo through the house.

Over time these memories begin to manifest into something more than the house itself. The pain and suffering carried across generations has taken shape as an entity that now inhabits the home, becoming another obstacle you must escape.

Gameplay

Watsonville is a single-player narrative horror experience designed specifically for virtual reality.

Players must piece together clues hidden throughout the home while navigating a frightening environment in order to escape both the house itself and the past that created it. Cassette tapes, photographs, and nostalgic household objects reveal fragments of the story as players search rooms and uncover hidden spaces.

Physical VR interaction allows players to crouch, crawl, climb, and manipulate objects while navigating tight areas throughout the house. Players use their microphone to trigger events and interact with the world. 

Features

• Environmental puzzles hidden within rooms and objects

• Narrative discovery through environmental storytelling, audio fragments, and family artifacts

• Atmospheric psychological horror rooted in memory, surreal imagination, nightmares, and generational trauma

• Full-body VR interaction and Voice Input allowing players to crouch, climb, hide, and use their voice to interact with the environment

• First-person VR through the eyes of a child creating vulnerability, an immersive experience of feeling small and a gateway to childhood nightmares

store_data.about_the_game:
Read between the lies in this first-person mystery puzzle game.

After every other library has been shut down, only one remains. You are assigned the role of its custodian, the last librarian.

Listen closely to patron's requests.

Use incomplete or sometimes ambiguous information to search the card catalogues and locate the correct book.

Identify. Recommend. Ban. Burn.

Your predecessor has vanished.

Hidden messages, forbidden books and whispers of a rebellion hint the library holds the key to a dangerous truth.

Can you solve the web of secrets within the puzzle box of the last library?

The resistance needs your help if they are to gather the evidence needed to topple the regime.

When do the ends justify the means?

This is a timely narrative puzzle game about censorship, power, and the manipulation of truth.

A cozy idle companion that stays on your screen while you work, study, or relax.

Choose your favorite style and display your farm on your desktop like a living picture.

Your farm keeps running even when the game is minimized.

While you work or study, your slimes continue to move, eat, and grow beside you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Mother Of All Battles is a turned based wargame, with simple 2D graphics, but pure strategy. Conquer the world starting from your single home city. Each city can build units (either tanks, planes, paratroopers, bombers, transports, destroyers, battleships, submarines or aircraft carriers) in order to explore the world and defeat the other five AI controlled enemy players. Each unit has its own strengths and weaknesses: submarines will easily sink battleships, battleships will easily sink destroyers, and destroyers will easily sink submarines.

There are 390 pre-set maps, the ability to create maps with your own custom settings, and a 'Game Of The Day' map so you can compare your abilities with other players.

store_data.about_the_game:
Totem Tower Defense combines deckbuilding and tower defense in a unique roguelite experience. Construct your totem from cards, merge its blocks for more powerful effects, and defend it from relentless waves of enemies.

  • Deck-Based Tower Building: Place and merge totem blocks using cards drawn between waves. Each run gives you new cards to expand and adapt your strategy.

  • Wave-Based Real-Time Combat: Position and rotate your totem’s shooting parts during waves to maximize your defense.

  • Roguelite Progression: Choose reward cards after completing each area. If you lose, rebuild your deck from your unlocked cards and try again.

  • Strategic Depth: Decide which cards to play, which blocks to merge, and where to place them — every choice can make the difference between victory and defeat.

Challenge yourself in multiple areas, merge your totem to its full potential, defeat waves of fantasy creatures, and craft the ultimate deck!

store_data.about_the_game:
The soup is simmering, but the horde is hungry! Step into a frantic, vertical-scrolling Tower Defense experience where strategy meets action. Defend the ultimate prize—your soup pot—from relentless waves of enemies dropping from the top of the screen.

Control your Chef, build intricate mazes, merge towers on the fly, and survive the onslaught. Can you take the heat?

Dynamic Tower Defense Meets Chef Action

You aren't just an idle commander—you are on the battlefield! Take direct control of your Chef to auto-attack enemies, unleash devastating spells, and even use your own body to block the horde.

  • Build & Maze: Place a variety of defensive towers to deal damage and alter enemy pathing.

  • Merge to Upgrade: Drop identical towers on top of each other to instantly evolve them.

  • Survive the Waves: Battle through intense 16-wave stages, featuring deadly mini-bosses and epic final encounters.

Endless Customization & Deep RPG Loot

Between battles, dive into a massive progression system to prepare for harder challenges:

  • The Kitchen Tech Tree: Spend your hard-earned Fish Cans and Gold to permanently upgrade Chef stats, enhance Tower effectiveness, or cripple enemy health and speed.

  • Loot & Equipment: Equip your Chef with Weapons, Hats, Aprons, and Backpacks. Hunt for high-rarity gear with game-changing passive skills (like flaming arrows or barrages) and merge duplicates all the way up to 5-Star Mythic rarity.

  • Recruit & Evolve: Unlock a diverse roster of Chefs (like the Butcher Cat) and Towers (Ballistas, Rocketeers, Mortars, and more). Gather duplicates to evolve them, unlocking massive stat caps and game-altering passive skills.

Multiple Ways to Play

  • Campaign Mode: Push through increasingly difficult Chapters and Stages to earn Gold, Diamonds, and Fish Cans.

  • Endless Mode: No limits, no mercy. Survive as long as you can on a single map and compete on the leaderboards for the highest wave cleared.

  • Boss Raid: Face off against an "Unkillable" boss in a 50-wave gauntlet. Deal as much damage as possible to climb the ranks and prove your culinary combat supremacy!

store_data.about_the_game:
The Sievert Scale is a surveillance horror game where you work as a newly appointed safety contractor in a UK based nuclear power plant. There is a growing public sentiment against nuclear power, with communities still reeling from Windscale and Chernobyl. Mandatory weekly safety audits are required by law.

Fail the audit, the plant ceases operations.

From your workstation, switch between live camera feeds across the facility - watch for safety contraventions, unusual behaviour and sinister activity. Capture evidence and report incidents before they spiral out of control.

Receive instructions from management via the internal email network. Beware, protocols can change mid-shift. What matters now may not matter later.

Prioritise carefully - not everything should be reported.

A standard shift lasts 60 - 90 minutes. Incidents escalate in real time. Stay alert, adapt to changing directives, and don't let anything slip through.

Some areas of the facility are not part of your initial assignment. As incidents escalate, new camera feeds may become accessible. What’s happening deeper inside the plant was never meant to be monitored.

MONITOR PLANT SAFETY

REPORT ALL INCIDENTS

FAILURE TO REPORT CONSTITUTES NEGLIGENCE

EXCESSIVE REPORTING DISRUPTS OPERATIONS

store_data.about_the_game:
Ninja Dodgeball

Step into the arena where reflexes, timing, and precision decide everything. In Ninja Dodgeball, players battle in fast-paced matches where a single ball becomes the ultimate weapon. Master its physics, deflect it with perfect timing, and send it flying back at your opponents at impossible speeds.

Inspired by classic dodgeball modes like Genji Dodgeball and TF2 Dodgeball, Ninja Dodgeball brings the concept into its own unique, skill-based arena experience.

Created by a solo-indie developer who does some basic grunt healthcare stuff as my job :D

Master the Ball

The ball isn’t just thrown — it’s controlled through skillful deflection and movement. Build momentum as players volley it back and forth until it becomes a lightning-fast projectile capable of taking down anyone in its path.

Ninja Movement

Stay alive with fast, responsive ninja abilities:

  • Reflect incoming balls back at enemies

  • Dash to evade impossible shots

  • Attack to redirect and control the ball’s trajectory

Precision and timing are everything. One mistake and you're out.

Fast Competitive Matches

Jump into intense arena matches where every round becomes a high-speed duel of reaction time and strategy. The longer a rally lasts, the faster and more dangerous the ball becomes.

Key Features

  • Fast-paced multiplayer dodgeball combat

  • Skill-based ball physics that reward precision

  • Reflect, dash, and attack mechanics for advanced play

  • Increasing ball speed that escalates every rally

  • Competitive arena gameplay focused on reflex and mind games

Only the fastest ninjas survive.

Can you deflect the impossible?

Inspired by classic dodgeball modes like Genji Dodgeball and TF2 Dodgeball, Ninja Dodgeball brings the concept into its own unique, skill-based arena experience.

Created by a solo-indie developer who does some basic grunt healthcare stuff as my job :D

Master the Ball

The ball isn’t just thrown — it’s controlled through skillful deflection and movement. Build momentum as players volley it back and forth until it becomes a lightning-fast projectile capable of taking down anyone in its path.

Ninja Movement

Stay alive with fast, responsive ninja abilities:

  • Reflect incoming balls back at enemies

  • Dash to evade impossible shots

  • Attack to redirect and control the ball’s trajectory

Precision and timing are everything. One mistake and you're out.

Fast Competitive Matches

Jump into intense arena matches where every round becomes a high-speed duel of reaction time and strategy. The longer a rally lasts, the faster and more dangerous the ball becomes.

Key Features

  • Fast-paced multiplayer dodgeball combat

  • Skill-based ball physics that reward precision

  • Reflect, dash, and attack mechanics for advanced play

  • Increasing ball speed that escalates every rally

  • Competitive arena gameplay focused on reflex and mind games

Only the fastest ninjas survive.

Can you deflect the impossible?
store_data.short_description: A fast-paced ninja dodgeball arena where reflexes are everything. Reflect, dash, and strike the ball to send it flying at your opponents as its speed increases with every volley. Play with up to 12 of your friends today!

store_data.about_the_game:
Meet Garsha

Garsha is a dominant orc warrior who enjoys being in charge. Strong, confident, and impossible to ignore, she is used to getting her way.

She is fierce in battle and just as dangerous when she smiles.

What begins as a tense encounter slowly turns into something neither of you expected.

A Dangerous Romance

Garsha does not make things easy.

She teases. She tests you. She pushes to see how far you will go.

Challenge her strength or give in to her dominant side. Your choices shape the romance and lead to different scenes and endings.

Animated Adult Scenes

As your relationship grows, you unlock spicy animated scenes presented as short video moments.

Unlocked scenes can be viewed anytime through the interactive gallery.

What to Expect

  • A choice-driven adult visual novel

  • A passionate monster girl romance with Garsha

  • Spicy animated scenes unlocked through the story

  • Playful power dynamics and teasing character moments

  • Multiple endings shaped by your choices

  • Light minigames to vary the experience

  • Part of the Velvet Labyrinth universe

Will You Win Her Heart?

Garsha is strong. Proud. Used to being in control.

But even the fiercest warrior can fall in love.

The question is simple.

Will you challenge her… or give in to her?


* * * * *

From the Black Codex of the Night Abbey, copied in a trembling hand and bound in cracked leather:

In the fading margins of ancient ink, the monks wrote of life and of dream, of the wandering spirit of a woman who walked the forgotten road beyond the white gate. It is said that in the elder medieval realm, before the fall of seven thrones, a strange narrative was whispered in cloisters and ruined tavern halls alike.

The tale begins not with glory but with a humble pie baked beside a roadside cafe, where a lone girl sat beneath a crooked roof, gazing into a tarnished mirror. Her dreamland visions were troubled by shadows: a vampire bride, a wandering orc hunter, and a silent killer whose blade gleamed with scarlet blood.

Many believed the legend mere madness, yet the gothic tales of the kingdom spoke otherwise. They told of wandering vikings, elf defenders, and a lonely dwarf slayer who traveled the ancient path through the haunted valley where werewolves howled beneath the star of the winter sky.

The monks warned that every traveler must make a choice, for the world itself is a puzzle crafted by god. Your wish may open one gate and close another. One road leads away from sorrow, another to the hidden dungeon where monster, fox, and wolf guard the buried treasure of the moonstone.

In those days the wandering orcs served a stern warchief, and rumors spoke of a muscular heroine among them, strong of muscle and bold of heart, a beautiful female orc whose character stirred both fear and romance. Some called her a princess, others a warrior woman, but the scrolls say she was simply a girl growing up in a land of endless wars.

She walked beneath the dark roof of forests and across coral island shores, where horses drank from streams and the song of the wind carried a melody through the trees. Her journey was an adventure, a fantastic adventure told in visual tales and whispered around the campfires of the camp beneath the volcano.

Many came with her: a wandering hunter, a quiet elf, a clever dog, and even a sly succubus who claimed to know the secret code of eden. Some were foreign, some were lucky, but all were bound by the same fragile thread of faith.

Through chaos, through war, through invasion and mass destruction, they traveled across the sandrock city, past the glowing neon street where demons danced and the air shimmered with magic.

Some nights they rested inside a ruined home, sharing fresh bread and a sweet drink brewed from a mysterious potion. Other nights they walked under the cold sky, each step echoing in the silence of time.

The monks wrote that the orc heroine had a strange theory about the soul. She believed that every being carried a hidden rune, a mark of fate that guided them through life, love, and death.

One night beside a flickering fire she did confess to her companions that she feared the nightmare of losing everything she held dear. For even the strongest warrior may die, and every path must someday end.

Yet hope remained. The clover fields near the island tavern shimmered with colorful blossoms, and the valley cafe served warm pie to weary travelers. There were moments of happiness, moments of date and gentle romantic love, where two souls might share a quiet prom night beneath the stars.

Still, the world was not without danger. A raging monster emerged from the hollow dungeon, and a cursed devil whispered promises of money, power, and forbidden lust. Some travelers were seduced, others stood firm with focus and order.

The scroll speaks of a strange effect that fell upon the land when the moonstone cracked. The core vein of the earth began to glow, opening a loop in time itself. Five days became one week, and nine dreams repeated like echoes in a broken mirror.

Through this immersive adventure, the companions fought in the arena of fate. Their combat was fierce, their courage stellar, their bonds forged in helping one another survive.

They crossed deserts of red sand, climbed the steps of ancient thrones, and faced the terrible dragons of the north. The empress of the ruined capital offered them a permit to enter the sacred paradise gate, but warned that no traveler who passed through would return unchanged.

There, at the edge of eternity, the muscular orc heroine stood beside her allies. Her hearts beat with courage as the wind carried a distant song across the realm.

She spoke softly.

“This is my fate. This is my adventure. Whether together or alone, we must come forward.”

And so they walked onward, walking into the unknown space between worlds, where genesis and final destruction sleep side by side.

Some say they found treasure.

Some say they found love.

Some say they found eden.

Others say they found only the silent gate.

Thus ends the edition of this scroll: heed the warnings, for in this realm pleasure and punish walk hand in hand, and every secret path leads, sooner or later, to the same dark gate.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Mystery Academy!

Experience life as a newcomer at a school for detectives!

Explore a mysterious island filled with secrets and challenges designed to push new students to their limits. Study, build relationships, solve puzzles, and most importantly: DON’T TRUST ANYONE!

Survive supernatural cases in this Visual Novel, build bonds with your classmates, forge your reputation as the future of the Redlore family, and rise to become the greatest detective in the world.

Deadtective Academy Features

  • Build relationships with dozens of unique characters, form strong friendships or even… romance.

  • Unlockable image gallery.

  • Multiple music tracks themed around each character, plus original sound effects.

  • Story with multiple endings.

  • Unlockable achievements.

  • Investigate crimes and solve cases within Mystery Academy.

  • Attend classes taught by the world’s greatest detectives.

  • Choose whether to protect your family’s reputation or forge your own path.

  • Carefully crafted personalities designed for fans who love deep storytelling.

Characters

Elizabeth Harrington
Heir to the prestigious Harrington family. Shy and studious, she doesn’t seem particularly remarkable at first glance… but you might be surprised.

Lucio Stone
A boy from a humble background whose cowardice may be bigger than his own height. However, his knowledge about birds is absolutely enormous.

Aurora Everwinter
Cold as the night and pale as moonlight. A true prodigy in the world of investigation, though she isn’t exactly great with people.

Thomas Silvas
Charming, a bit of a rogue, and someone who knows how to enjoy life. Something tells me he has a thing for older women…

Seraphine Kingsley
A vegan and passionate animal lover, Seraphine is as sweet as honey and inseparable from her kitten, Will.

Kate
A true gamer who prefers sleepless nights playing video games over quiet afternoons studying… even if it means skipping a few showers.

Kael Eryndor
Tall and strong, yet lacking confidence in himself. Coming from a family of police officers, he dreams of making his mark in the world of investigation.

Emma Valkov
Elliot’s twin sister. Eccentric, vain, and extremely intelligent. Just be careful not to fall for her provocations.

Elliot Valkov
Emma’s twin brother. Elliot loves photography, but he loves his sister even more.

Nico Blake
A true hacker. Nico is a genius when it comes to computers and understands technology like no one else. Many also say he’s incredibly friendly.

Dante Leclair
A Romeo searching for his Juliet. The only problem is… apparently every girl at Mystery Academy seems to fit that role.

Roxy
Ghosts, aliens, vampires, werewolves, and conspiracy theories — this girl is fascinated by all of them. To be honest, even we can’t fully explain her.

Dracilla
Intelligence isn’t exactly her strong suit… and her dietary preferences are a little unusual.

And many more…

store_data.about_the_game:
What seemed like a fresh start soon turns into something much darker. As personal struggles grow and reality begins to feel unstable, Nicolás finds himself trapped in a town that no longer makes sense.

After a mysterious event causes the entire town to vanish, Nicolás is forced to descend into an impossible underground structure. There, he discovers a massive abandoned complex shrouded in darkness, filled with hostile creatures and disturbing signs that something is very wrong. With no clear way out, the player must explore the environment, solve strategic puzzles, and survive while trying to progress.

The town is no longer the place he knew. The streets are blanketed in dense fog. Most of the population has disappeared without explanation. Communications are down. The world feels abandoned and disconnected from reality.

Determined to understand what happened, Nicolás continues seeking answers while trying to find a way back home. Along the way, he encounters his ex-girlfriend Ana and other survivors who were also trapped during the event.

As the journey progresses, reality becomes increasingly unstable.

What if the truth is not just tied to the town…?

Key Features

First-person psychological horror experience

Story-driven gameplay

Extensive environmental exploration

Melee combat and firearms

Complex puzzles and interactive elements

Inventory-based progression system

Atmospheric and immersive sound design

Offline single-player experience

store_data.about_the_game:
Build your deck before the battle begins!

Pixelords is a 2D pixel art autobattler where victory is decided not during combat, but in the preparation phase.

Assemble your squad, freely place your units on a gridless battlefield, and watch your strategy unfold.

Read your opponent’s composition, create synergies, and turn the tide with a single placement.

[Strategic Unit Placement]

Command 35 units across 10 different elements.

In Pixelords, there are no fixed tiles on the battlefield. You can place units anywhere you want, and every position becomes part of your strategy.

Frontline units hold the line, Rangers attack from the rear, and Guardians protect key allies.

The flow of battle changes completely depending on how you arrange your formation.

• 3 Roles — Attacker, Ranger, Guardian

Each role behaves differently in combat.

• 3 Traits — Hasty, Daring, Cunning

They determine which enemies your units prioritize.

• 3 Cost Tiers

Stronger units require more resources. Managing your coins is also a key part of strategy.

[Elemental Synergies]

Place units of the same element together to make them even stronger.

Each element has its own unique synergy effect, and the combinations you choose can completely change your battle style.

Combine elemental advantages and synergies to create your own formation.

[Various Game Modes]

• Arena — Real-time 1v1 ranked battles

Read your opponent’s composition, outplay them with positioning, and climb to higher tiers.

• Expedition — A PvE mode with 5 chapters and 11 stages each

Earn up to 3 stars on every stage, where unit management and coin economy are the keys to victory.

• Trials — A 1–4 player co-op endless survival mode

A shared battlefield, separate economies, and blessings granted on each floor create a new strategy every run.

[4-Player Co-op]

In Trials, up to 4 players fight together on a single battlefield.

Cover each other’s weaknesses, coordinate your builds, and see how far you can survive together.

Bosses appear every 10 floors to test your teamwork.

[SPELLS]

You can bring up to 3 spells into battle.

Healing, shields, stuns, and direct damage — use them at the right moment to turn the tide.

But spells use the same coins as unit placement.

Every choice comes at a cost.

[RELICS]

A permanent progression system exclusive to PvE mode. Grow 4 distinct Relics — melee unit power, ranged unit power, spell potency, and economic strength — to forge your own playstyle. Level up through play, earn points, and strengthen your Relics one by one.

[COLLECTION]

Your one-stop guide to everything in the game — units, spells, elements, skins, and more. See what you've uncovered and track down what's still waiting to be found.

• 3 Cost Tiers

Stronger units require more resources. Managing your coins is also a key part of strategy.

[Elemental Synergies]

Place units of the same element together to make them even stronger.

Each element has its own unique synergy effect, and the combinations you choose can completely change your battle style.

Combine elemental advantages and synergies to create your own formation.

[Various Game Modes]

• Arena — Real-time 1v1 ranked battles

Read your opponent’s composition, outplay them with positioning, and climb to higher tiers.

• Expedition — A PvE mode with 5 chapters and 11 stages each

Earn up to 3 stars on every stage, where unit management and coin economy are the keys to victory.

• Trials — A 1–4 player co-op endless survival mode

A shared battlefield, separate economies, and blessings granted on each floor create a new strategy every run.

[4-Player Co-op]

In Trials, up to 4 players fight together on a single battlefield.

Cover each other’s weaknesses, coordinate your builds, and see how far you can survive together.

Bosses appear every 10 floors to test your teamwork.

[SPELLS]

You can bring up to 3 spells into battle.

Healing, shields, stuns, and direct damage — use them at the right moment to turn the tide.

But spells use the same coins as unit placement.

Every choice comes at a cost.

[RELICS]

A permanent progression system exclusive to PvE mode. Grow 4 distinct Relics — melee unit power, ranged unit power, spell potency, and economic strength — to forge your own playstyle. Level up through play, earn points, and strengthen your Relics one by one.

[COLLECTION]

Your one-stop guide to everything in the game — units, spells, elements, skins, and more. See what you've uncovered and track down what's still waiting to be found.
store_data.short_description: Pixelords is a 2D pixel art autobattler where victory is decided before battle begins. Build a squad from 10 elements and 35 units, place them freely on a gridless battlefield, and enjoy solo campaign, 4-player co-op Trials, and real-time PvP.

store_data.about_the_game:
Arduus: Minimalist Open World Survival Craft RPG was created with the idea of combining RPG, survival, and strategy elements into a simple, direct, and intuitive experience.

You are literally thrown into the medieval fantasy world of Arduus and start from nothing — with no tutorials guiding every step. Your character appears at a random location in a vast procedurally generated open world, and from that moment on everything is up to you: explore, survive, evolve, and find your own path.

You might choose to live a quiet life in the frozen mountains, become a spice merchant traveling across the scorching desert, or simply work at a small village tavern while saving money to buy your own home, there is no single path to follow — the adventure is shaped by the choices you make and the life you decide to build in this world.

  • Open World Sandbox – Freely explore a procedural world that can reach up to 1000x1000 tiles (1,000,000 tiles to explore).

  • Character Progression – Learn new knowledge and unlock advantages that shape your playstyle.

  • Mercy or Death – After every battle, decide the fate of your defeated enemies.

  • Resource Gathering – Collect herbs, ore, wood, and other resources.

  • Survival – Manage hunger, thirst, fatigue, injuries, fractures, and harsh weather conditions.

  • Crafting – Create tools, weapons, and armor to use or sell.

  • Dynamic Trading – Prices change depending on the merchant and the local economy of each region.

  • Shadow Market – Trade goods and services beyond the reach of the law.

  • Turn-Based Combat – Semi-automatic battles where you command your units each turn.

  • Low RNG Combat – Battles are designed so experience and strategy matter more than luck.

Hi! I'm Jimmy, the creator of Arduus. Thank you for giving the game a chance and taking the time to check out this page.

I'm a big fan of RPG and strategy games, but I've always felt there was room for experiences that offer depth without requiring hours to learn complex systems. That idea is what led me to start developing Arduus.

The goal has always been to create an open world with clear, intuitive, and easy-to-learn mechanics, where you can explore, survive, progress, and build at your own pace.

From the beginning, the game has been designed to receive constant updates, allowing the world to expand, new content to be added, and the game to evolve alongside the community.

If you'd like to follow the development and share ideas, you're more than welcome to join the community.
Your feedback helps shape the future of Arduus — and it makes a huge difference to me as a developer.

Step into the glowing lights of a neon pub and test your luck in Luck of the Draw, an unpredictable card battle where every draw matters.

The rules are simple—but victory is anything but.

Players take turns drawing and playing cards from a shared deck, each one capable of shifting the balance of the match. Your objective is to give your opponent 5 hearts before they manage to give you 5.

Sounds easy… until the deck starts working against you.

Set on a stylish neon pub stage, each round becomes a tense back-and-forth of risk, timing, and pure luck. One perfect card can be the one to make your opponent cum.

Features

Varied Card Battles
Draw from the deck and play cards that influence the flow of the match.

Heart-Based Win Condition
The first player to lose ALL hearts loses. Pass them to your opponent before they pass them to you.

Neon Pub Atmosphere
Battle on a vibrant stage filled with glowing lights and nightlife energy.

Luck Meets Strategy
Every card draw can flip the outcome of the game.

Quick, Replayable Matches
Short, intense rounds make every game feel different.

In Luck of the Draw, fortune favors the bold… but the deck always has the final say.

store_data.about_the_game:
An Endless Stream of Space Debris

In the distant future, humanity discovered the mysterious substance 'Ether' and embarked on a path of explosive expansion. "What is left in the wake of humanity's conquest across the stars?" Philosophers, activists, and politicians debate this endlessly. But if someone asked you right now, your answer would be simple: nothing but a massive mountain of garbage.

Why?

Because you fell victim to a joint-surety scam and got dragged off to a waste disposal station on a prison planet at the edge of the galaxy. To get out of here—or just to survive another week—you have to work every single day to pay off your massive debt.

The endless junk pouring onto the conveyor belt day after day isn't just trash; it's a recyclable resource and your only ticket to salvation.

Unlock numerous blueprints and use over 15 different crafting tools. Grab the debris, process it, and transform the scraps into high-value goods.

Do EVERYTHING yourself.

You can't just pop down to the local mart or visit the neighboring planet's mega-mall. This is a prison you know.

You have to make everything yourself—from the tools you use, to the very opportunity to escape this hellhole.

Betting and Gambling: An Irresistible Temptation

Sick of doing honest work? Of course you are, Who doesn't?

Fortunately, there's a place even in this miserable joint for people who want to get rich quick.

And for those people, this prison offers a very tempting alternative.

Welcome to the weekly Arena—where the line between "sports" and "bloody gang warfare" is practically non-existent. As a non-violent financial criminal, you aren't allowed to fight in it (or even watch it, really—you just get bullied out of your lunch money). But hey, the betting pool is open to everyone!

Chase that jackpot dream by betting on the Arena, or try your luck at the infamous fair matching game that has bankrupted countless inmates before you.

That is... if you have a really sharp eye.

Use Your Words, Not Just Your Wrench

"No man is an island"—and that goes double when you're locked in a space prison.

Buy insider info from sketchy brokers to conquer the betting pool with actual strategy, or eavesdrop on the bartender for some juicy tips. Interact with a colorful cast of inmates, complete their quests, and reap the rewards.

Will you reclaim your hope and buy your freedom through endless, grueling labor? Or will you just be buried alive under an infinite stream of cosmic trash...?

And more importantly... can you uncover the dark secret hidden deep within this station?

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to a city where the sun has gone out forever.

It never stops raining. Neon signs cast their last rays on the wet asphalt, and the shadows have become home to those who don't come out in the light. You are the one who comes in the night. Your goal? To get to the bottom of things. Your methods? Deadly.

A city that breathes betrayal

Immerse yourself in a dark story, shattered by the blows of a revolver hammer. Who are you: a detective on the brink of madness, a mercenary with a broken past, or an executioner carrying out the sentence of this city? The truth is hidden in the clouds of cigarette smoke and the echoes of gunshots.

A deadly dance in three dimensions

Forget about gunfights in the corridors. Every corner is a trap, and every door is a one-way ticket. The hardcore mechanics of "one hit equals death" make you think and move faster than the enemy.

The aesthetics of pure noir

The entire world is designed in a strict, dark color scheme, with the only bright spot being the cold neon of signs and lamps. The deep shadows conceal the enemy.

Now, specifically about what awaits you:

Hardcore gameplay

  • Enemies die with a single hit, but you will also die from a single bullet.

  • React lightning fast: decision time is measured in fractions of a second.

Visual aesthetics

  • A gloomy world: a world in dull colors, where the only color is the light of lanterns and neon.

  • An atmosphere of despair created by the sounds of rain and the echo of gunshots.

Content

  • 14 cards.

  • 16 weapons, from pistols to shotguns.

  • 3 enemies, from street dogs to the head of the mafia.

Are you ready to find out what lies behind the rain? The lights go out, and it's time to make your move.

Adventure is fully automatic!

“Gun Girl Go” is a game that actually turned those Run & Gun ads you always see into a real game.

Race through handcrafted tracks packed with sharp turns, ramps, obstacles, and surprises. The world may look playful, but the racing is intense, chaotic, and highly competitive. Quick reactions, smart powerup usage, and adapting to constant changes are the keys to victory.

📦 Built From Cardboard

Enter a unique DIY world where every track, prop, and kart feels handcrafted.
From taped edges to layered textures, each environment brings a playful yet detailed racing experience.

Pick up powerups during races to gain the edge—or cause chaos.
Boost ahead, slow rivals, or disrupt the track at just the right moment to turn the race in your favor.

Every lap brings new surprises. Every race tells a different story.

Boost ahead, slow rivals, or disrupt the track at just the right moment to turn the race in your favor.

Expect:

  • Unexpected chaos that forces instant adaptation

No two races ever play the same.

🎭 Unique Characters & Karts

Mix and match to find your perfect racing style.

🎲 Unpredictable Races

🏎️ Fast, Accessible Arcade Racing

Easy to pick up, hard to master.
Whether you're drifting through corners or battling for first place, the action never slows down.

🚀 About the Game

Kartboard Dash is designed to deliver fast, chaotic, and endlessly replayable races.

Every lap brings new surprises. Every race tells a different story.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Cosmic Doom" is a real-time strategy game set against the backdrop of spiritual energy revival, blending ancient mythology and super-science fiction to create a dynamic battlefield full of strategic depth and thrilling gameplay. The game centres on authentic N VS N real-time battles; various spiritual warheads, landmines, and macro warfare support; epic grand storyline, embarking on an almost 'unlimited' war journey!

Epic storyline, faction choices:

Across all worlds, humanity is in peril; the last human guardians of the Galactic Fortress, under the command of 'Emperor Xi', usher in the final era; the humans of Earth become the last spark, setting out on a journey; calamities of all races across the heavens begin, to prove the name of humanity!

Macro strategy, real-time confrontation:

A full display of real-time tactics; commanders plan the overall strategy, besiege cities, protect, slay generals, everyone performing their roles, utilising each person's talents; everyone can find their place, low combat power is not a problem, a single spark can start a prairie fire!

Talents and micro-control reign supreme:

Blade jumps, wind staves, flash, magic immunity, invincibility; all talent skills are available; overcoming the strong with the weak, conquering all lands; the higher the APM, the more exhilarating the combat experience.

No resource sales, strategic warfare:

Committed to fair competition, all victories depend on team composition, operational skills, and vision control. Whether an SLG player who loves macro layouts, or an RTS/MOBA enthusiast passionate about micro-control battles, everyone can find deep enjoyment.

Visual innovation, modern cultivation:

Spiritual energy revival, genetic reconstruction! A wasteland punk path of evolution, gradually embarking on the deep space journey, the primordial lands await your rescue!

—We are the calamity of all worlds in this deep space!

This time, you are reborn. You must defy your doomed fate as the villain and reclaim everything that is rightfully yours.

Avoid My Death Ending is a survival-focused Text Adventure × Turn-based RPG.

You were the author of this novel—until you transmigrated into the body of its doomed villain, facing an imminent death ending.

Surrounded by characters who despise you, you have been reborn into this crisis. You must make different choices to rewrite your destiny.

■ World Exploration: Diverse Interactive Scenes

From the quiet halls of your manor to the chaotic Black Markets and martial arenas. Every node on the map hides random events and vital intel. Rational planning is the key to your survival.

store_data.about_the_game:
Forget those leisurely farm simulations. In this game:

  • You farm, not to expand your farm, but to avoid starving to death in winter.

  • You make friends, not to collect gifts, but to have someone vouch for you when government soldiers come to conscript you.

  • Every NPC is part of your survival strategy—they could be your lifeline or your death warrant.

  • *Refugee of a Lost Age* is a survival simulator that takes the "interpersonal relationship system" to the extreme. You will be immersed in a dynamic micro-society filled with calculations and warmth. Every sowing, every conversation, every knock on the door in the dead of night is a life-or-death choice. Your goal is simple: as an insignificant nobody in an era of heroes, do your utmost to survive until the end.

  • Your hand, which just gripped a hoe, has just let go of your neighbor's cold corpse. He owed you three bushels of wheat last week, but now, all you find in his arms is half a moldy pancake.

    This is not murder; it's just an ordinary dusk in some year.

  • In the game *Refugee of a Lost Age*, you will experience the life of a commoner completely crushed by grand history. What you need to calculate is not the profit from crops, but whether to curry favor with the local gentry or help the widow who might not survive the winter before the next famine strikes. Your granary and your conscience can never be filled at the same time.

store_data.about_the_game:
Have you ever wondered if your dreams were designed by someone?

Ivy never used to dream.
Until one night, she does.

The dream feels strange, almost like it was planned in advance. Some of the things in it seem to exist in the real world too.

As nightmares begin to spread across Dream Town, Ivy finds herself pulled into something much bigger than she expected. Something connected to her dream, and to someone she has completely forgotten.

Learn magic, uncover the rules of dreams, and travel between dreams, illusions, and reality as you search for answers.

Can you uncover the secret behind the dream?

  • Run a magical cafe: grow plants, brew dream-inspired drinks, and comfort visiting souls

  • Solve puzzles: decode dream runes, unlock memories, and piece together broken stories

  • Investigate the truth: follow subtle hints, and reveal what was never spoken aloud

  • Dream magic: cast spells, traverse nightmares, and track dream beasts

  • Make emotional choices: decide whether to question, protect, forgive, or let go

  • Visual & audio style: hand-painted dreamscapes, emotional lighting, and original healing soundtrack

  • A story that resonates : explore themes of identity, self-perception, and emotional struggles through a gentle, women perspective narrative

• Shan Hai's Splendour, Truly Rendered,

  • Mystic Familiars, Friendship Gendered.

  • Tactical Fights, Where Fortunes Are Spurned,

  • Farm and Flourish, A Life Well Earned.

  • Gather Your Mates, For Epic Boss Raids!

[Spirit Demon Tribulation] is an exquisitely beautiful mmorpg inspired by the "Shan Hai Jing" (Classic of Mountains and Seas). Its meticulously crafted world scenes and wonderfully agile spirit characters are all designed from the classic mythological stories found within the "Shan Hai Jing".

In ancient times, a great war erupted between the Witch and Demon clans. The Three Sovereigns of the Demon Clan and the Twelve Ancestral Witches perished together. Then, the Great Demon Taihao emerged, uniting the Demon Clan and quelling the chaos. However, the lingering resentment of the Witch Clan attracted the Demon God Xie Tu, who imprisoned Taihao, plunging the Demon Clan into disarray. The Demon God Xuanyuan confronted Xie Tu. Unable to defeat Xuanyuan, Xie Tu suffered a crushing defeat and fled. Yet, Yan Mo, still resentful, impersonated Taihao and ambushed Xuanyuan. Xuanyuan suffered severe injuries, with only a wisp of his soul left to wander through the chaos. And this is where our story begins: Demon Lords will transform into Xuanyuan's lingering soul, embarking on a journey through the mountains and seas to recover memories and weapons...
