store_data.about_the_game:
After several meteors strike the Earth over 48 hours, a strange and terrifying phenomenon emerges from the depths. Unknown creatures invade the surface, and the world as we knew it is no more. You are one of the last survivors in this devastated world, where each night becomes a true nightmare.

Under Us is a survival horror game where tension is ever-present. The days are your only opportunity to prepare, explore, and plan. But as soon as the sun sets, everything changes... the darkness takes over, and nightmarish creatures roam, ready to devour you. Every night is a battle for survival.

Key Features:

  • Immersive Storyline: Dive into a mysterious narrative, with unsettling revelations as the game progresses. Uncover terrifying secrets about the meteors' origins and the creatures that have overrun the planet.

  • Sandbox Mode: Explore and survive at your own pace in a free-roam mode, either solo or with friends. Discover hidden locations, build shelters, and endure the dangers of the night in an open-world environment.

  • Unpredictable and Terrifying Nights: When night falls, anything can happen. Creatures become more aggressive, strange phenomena occur, and the atmosphere becomes increasingly tense. Be prepared for the unexpected.

  • Realistic Survival System: Eat, drink, and hunt to stay alive. Find sources of water, hunt animals for food, and craft survival tools to endure in a hostile environment.

  • Building and Tool Crafting: Build sturdy shelters to withstand harsh weather and lurking creatures. Craft weapons, traps, and intricate structures to protect yourself from the threats that surround you.

  • Complex Ecosystem: The wildlife in Under Us interacts with the environment and other creatures in realistic ways. Predators, prey, scavengers, and passive-aggressive creatures—all these factors influence the game's dynamics, creating a living, breathing world.

  • Experience and Attribute System: Gain experience to enhance your skills and customize your survival style. Allocate points to different attributes to help you face the growing threats.

  • Mini-Games and Rare Loot: Unlock mini-games as you progress. These challenges will reward you with rare weapons and protection gear.

  • No Microtransactions: No in-game purchases! Everything you need is available as soon as you enter the world of Under Us.

An ancient fortress, miles long but barely functional, its last captain dust for a million years. Its automated systems are running on fumes. It needs a captain. It needs crew. It needs someone to tell it what to do.

BUILD YOUR FORTRESS

Your ship is yours to create and modify, strut by strut. Draw hull shapes with circles, ellipses, and curves. Snap modules onto the skeleton. Every reactor, weapon, and engine has a real position on the hull, and that position matters. An exposed reactor on the port side? That's a death sentence when the enemy flanks you. A clever builder hides their weak points and creates killing arcs of fire.

FIGHT LIKE AN ADMIRAL, NOT A PILOT

This isn't a dogfight. It's Age of Sail combat with super-capital ships. Your fortress groans through turns. Bringing your broadside to bear is a commitment. Shields absorb fire in directional quadrants. Hull plating and armor protects vital modules until its scorched, cracked, and finally breached. When your hull is shattered, enemy fire pours through holes in your armor straight into the guts of your ship. Fighters swarm. Torpedoes track. Point defense chatters. Every battle leaves marks, and your ship tells the story of every fight it survived.

CONQUER A LIVING GALAXY

Thematic AI factions hold territory, field named captains, and wage war against each other — whether you're watching or not. Forge alliances, commit betrayals, or let your enemies exhaust each other while you expand. Sectors aren't just battlegrounds, they're valuable territory providing crew, resources, and empire-strengthening improvements to invest in. Build academies, refineries, fuel depots, and defense platforms to protect Earth from raiding enemies.

LOOT, CRAFT, AND RESEARCH

Modules drop from destroyed enemies with randomized rarity, stat modifiers, and durability — a legendary railgun pulled from a wreck might outperform your crafted gear even at 60% condition. Early game, you scavenge to survive. Late game, investment in research and industry means you can create exotic equipment that fuses alien technologies to create things no-one has ever seen.

Multiple factions. Multiple aesthetics. Industrial grit welded to function. Bio-organic ships that grow instead of being built. Necromantic hulks animated by void energy. Steampunk brass-and-copper contraptions running on reactors fueled by coal. Research faction-specific tech. Equip fighter bays and mix squadrons of brass automatons, drone swarms armed with laser arrays, and undead bombers piloted by ghosts. Nobody said galactic conquest had to make sense!

store_data.about_the_game:
Survive the Void

Inspired by 90s FPS arcade games and survival horror game design, The Void is a relentless FPS that demands both quick reflexes and calculated, tactical restraint and calculated resource management. 

You are armed with a single gun. There is no armory to fall back on. Resources spawn at the church once in a while. Doing more with less is the strategy that helps you survive. 

Find Absolution

Every pickup is a calculated risk, and Every missed shot brings you closer to death

To survive the Void, you must become an instrument of absolute destruction against an unrelenting nightmare.

Key Features

  • Momentum is your greatest asset. Outmaneuver, and always stay a step ahead.

  • Resources are scarce, and spawns are limited. Play carefully.

  • Use precise strikes, and environmental awareness to survive.

  • Face legions of demons in an unforgiving landscape- as the arena shifts from a hunting ground to a claustrophobic trap the longer you survive.

store_data.about_the_game:
# A Perfect Blend of Nostalgia and Action

WonderKing is a side-scrolling MMORPG that combines classic 2D graphics with a modern combat feel. With simple controls, you can unleash flashy skills that fill the screen and enjoy the thrill of hunting down hordes of monsters in the field. Choose from four distinct starting classes—Swordsman, Mage, Archer, and Thief—and grow your character to unlock eight advanced classes, experiencing even more powerful skills and spectacular effects.

# Strategic Boss Raids with Allies

Powerful boss monsters like Pruneus are daunting to face alone, but with allies, you have nothing to fear. Form a party of up to 5 players and utilize the unique characteristics of each class to engage in strategic cooperative play against massive threats. Conquer various powerful bosses and succeed in raids to earn legendary items worthy of your victory.

# My Unique Style, Community, and Customization

After a fierce battle, relax in town and show off your unique personality. Complete your style from head to toe with hundreds of costume combinations, and set off on adventures with cute pets that boost your stats or mounts that help you travel quickly. Gather in the town square to chat with other users, use various character expressions to show your emotions, and forge new bonds.

# An Endlessly Unfolding World of Adventure

Sometimes, take a break from fighting monsters. Test your limits by challenging platforming sections that require delicate control, or spend a relaxing time discovering various activities hidden throughout the fields. Additionally, special seasonal events—such as beautiful maps filled with cherry blossoms—will bring unique fun and vitality to your adventure.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tokyo Wave Rush is an arcade racer where vibrant, stylized Japan meets precision physics. Carve through dynamic water, outmaneuver rivals, and dominate the tides in a sun-drenched tribute to the golden age of arcade racing.

A LOVE LETTER TO 90s ARCADE RACERS

Step into a world of vibrant, stylized realism. Inspired by the "Blue Sky" aesthetics of 90s console and arcade legends, every race feels like a postcard from a Japanese summer vacation—complete with volumetric golden-hour lighting and shimmering, crystal-clear waters.

FLUID, SOULFUL PHYSICS

Experience water that doesn't just look beautiful but feels alive. A custom buoyancy system captures the rhythmic, satisfying "bounce" of classic wave racing, refined with modern precision for a smooth, flow-state experience. Animation is refined to give a game-feel that rivals the best in the genre.

CITY POP & NEON LIGHTS

Race to the pulse of a soundtrack that blends nostalgic city pop and smooth jazzy grooves. From the midday glare of coastal shrines to the soft glow of urban waterways at dusk, the atmosphere is designed to be as much of an escape as it is a competition.

A JOURNEY ACROSS STYLIZED JAPAN

Whether you’re weaving through the tight corridors of a metropolitan canal or navigating wide-open ocean sprints, the world is a tribute to the architecture and energy of iconic Japanese locales.

store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO PIPREAL

Step into a nostalgic 80s–90s atmosphere in a sandbox exploration game where freedom comes first.

Pipreal is a sandbox exploration game where players can freely explore environments, interact with objects, use tools like spray paint, and experiment with in-game systems. You wake up in the mysterious city of Liftograd — a place where time has frozen. Explore buildings, discover secrets, create graffiti, or cause chaos — the choice is yours.

🎯 WHAT YOU CAN DO IN THE GAME

Explore detailed locations: Apartment buildings, garages, a local shop, an abandoned office, and the village of Mayovo.

Full access: Enter buildings, staircases, basements, and rooftops.

Express yourself: Use spray paint to create graffiti anywhere in the world.

Interact with systems: Ride old-school elevators, use ATMs, and find hidden combinations.

Break the rules: Manipulate game systems (including elevators) and search for secret Easter eggs.

You can also turn off your neighbor's lights, take out the trash, or if you want to eat, you can buy bread at the bread store.

🎮 CORE FEATURES

Creative Freedom: Turn the city into your canvas. Paint walls, entrances, and hidden corners — leave your mark everywhere.

Reactive Environment: Your actions affect navigation and open alternative paths. Interact with environmental systems to find new ways forward.

Exploration: Discover a map inspired by 80s–90s aesthetics. Every location, from apartment courtyards to interior hallways, is designed to feel atmospheric and lived-in.

🚀 THE FUTURE OF PIPREAL

Pipreal is an evolving project. Our roadmap includes:

Version 2.0: Characters, NPC interactions, and an expanded economy system.

Upcoming Updates: Drivable vehicles, larger map districts, and more interaction tools.

💡 WHY PLAY NOW?

Pipreal is our first major project, built with passion using Unity. By playing now, you are supporting the development of a growing world and helping shape its future.

Drop into a massive top-down arena where 100 players race through a procedurally generated maze and fight to control the most powerful weapon in the cave.

- Procedurally generated maze every game

- Stick power system with high-risk, high-reward gameplay

- Fast-paced combat with throws, melee, and movement abilities

- Dynamic hazards including fire, portals, and roaming creatures

store_data.about_the_game:
Cast magic with your bare hands — Using your webcam, perform hand signs to unleash spells in Majestic Signs! No webcam? Keyboard and controller work great too. Battle against friends online, defeat bosses in Adventure Mode, and prove that you're the strongest sorcerer!

Cast all kinds of magic!

Cast light orbs at your enemies, or burn them with your magic. Throw them into walls or summon strong creatures to fight for you. And if you become strong enough, you can even cast your own terrain!

Play in a Battle Royal or Teams! Or challenge someone to a 1v1 match!

This game supports different modes to play with friends. You can even customize stats to make a "boss" like opponent for everyone to defeat!

Strategy

In this world, you have to be smart and think out your plan. Study your enemy and their strengths and weaknesses. Know your own limitations! What's your gameplan? Do you plan to fight in close quarters or will you keep your distance? Are you a riskier fighter? All of your stats are important in different ways, so be mindful of that when customizing! And maybe most importantly, watch your stamina! It can run out!

Become the ultimate wizard

Find the playstyle that matches you best. Travel through Adventure Mode to defeat bosses and unlock items. Challenge your friends as the strongest. 

Unlock several different items!

  • 75+ Moves : The move types are : ORB, FIRE, ICE, SHOCK, WIND, DARK, SLASH, POISON, HEAL, SUMMON, Unclassified. Unlock them via leveling up, repetitive move use and completing Adventure Mode!

  • 25 Contracts : Powerful buffs that also give debuffs, collect them in Adventure Mode!

  • 15 Talents : Slight Buffs, unlock them via leveling up!

  • 8 Weapons : Staffs & Swords with varying abilities, unlock them by defeating enemies in Adventure Mode!

  • Adventure Mode (12 Stages) : Defeat varying bosses to unlock moves, and to solidify your place as the strongest.

Features:

  • Hand Tracking : Movement/Combat/Magic Casting (Webcam required for this feature!)

  • Voice : Scream to power up!

  • Supports Controller : Exception : Text input fields have to be typed manually

  • Private multiplayer up to 8 players : so chaotic battles are bound to happen. (If requested by enough people, public lobbies can be added later!)

  • Character Customization : Choose your looks and stats!

  • Weapon Stealing : Knock out your enemies and take their weapon. Or just make them drop it and take it by force!

  • Terrain Destruction : Destroy the environment with your epic battles!

  • Throw / Pick-up objects : Throw blocks at your enemies or your enemies at blocks!

  • Power Up in the middle of battle : Strong sorcerers are capable of evolving in the heat of battle!

  • Soccer : Some online stages let you play soccer. First to score 10 wins! (Any goal is up for grabs!)

store_data.about_the_game:
What is RuneClick?

RuneClick is a desktop overlay RPG that turns your daily computer use into character progression. A pixel art medieval character lives on your screen and reacts to your real keyboard and mouse input. Type an email, he chops a tree. Click through a spreadsheet, he mines ore. Close your laptop, he does nothing. Every keystroke is progress. Every click counts.

The Grind is Real

Six skills. Three gathering, three production. Everything connects. Woodcutting fuels Smithing and Crafting. Fishing feeds Cooking. Mining supplies the whole chain. You gather raw materials, turn them into gear and food, sell what you don't need, and work toward what you do. Level cap is 99 per skill. XP keeps counting after that. Maxing out takes months of real use. That's by design.

Gear Up

Craft tools that make you gather faster. Cook food that boosts your XP. Cut gems into jewelry with passive bonuses. Five tiers of progression across every gathering skill, with extremely rare variants at the top that you'll be chasing for a long time. Every upgrade is something you built from materials you earned.

It Lives on Your Desktop

RuneClick isn't a window you switch to. It's a transparent overlay that sits on top of your taskbar while you work, browse, or play other games. Click through it. Drag it anywhere. Scale it up or down. It launches with Windows, saves automatically, and never steals focus. It's a companion, not a distraction.

Mod Everything

Add new skills, items, and recipes with simple JSON files. Want full control? Write GDScript mods with access to every system in the game. Share your creations on Steam Workshop. A complete template mod with an example skill is included to get you started.

Features

  • Always-on-top desktop overlay with click-through transparency

  • 6 interconnected skills with progression to 99 and beyond

  • Gear, tools, jewelry, consumables, and rare variants

  • A real economy with a General Store and anti-arbitrage pricing

  • Steam leaderboards with server-side anti-cheat

  • Discord and Steam Rich Presence

  • 30 Steam achievements

  • Steam Cloud saves

  • Full mod support with Steam Workshop

  • Scales from 50% to 150%

store_data.about_the_game:
[Core Gameplay]

The game features a Roguelike-Tower Defense hybrid, primarily drawing inspiration from three titles: Slay the Spire, Brotato, and Arknights. It follows a spire-climbing style Roguelike challenge where players select talents after each battle. Players can deploy and strengthen operators, choosing talent cards to enhance their build—including Defense Cards, Attack Cards, and Special Cards.

Players must find the optimal solution among various operator characters based on the battlefield situation, constructing unique combinations to counter enemy assaults. Additionally, players can actively attack enemy spawn points to strike back.

[Characters and Progression]

Players take on the role of the Demon King, embarking on a journey across the continent. Failure does not mean permanent death; instead, players are "reborn." Each rebirth allows players to strengthen themselves based on their performance in the previous run. The game features multiple BGM tracks that switch according to the scene. The art style is primarily 2D anime-style illustrations, while the in-game character sprites are designed in a "chibi" (Q-version) style.

The "Rebirth" mechanism creates a complete growth loop. The chibi characters, paired with dynamic background music, provide a comfortable strategic environment for both visual and auditory senses.

[Unique Narrative Experience]

Players receive a "Story Card" upon clearing a stage, allowing them to choose when to watch the plot unfold. This ensures that the flow of intense gameplay is never interrupted by sudden, lengthy story segments. While players can view the story at any time, there may be a mandatory 2–3 second narrative beat after clearing a stage to ensure players know who they are fighting, preventing a total loss of immersion or mindless combat.

About This Game

Welcome to the Gritty Grind of Professional Wrestling. In Squared Circle Tycoon, Terminal Software puts you in charge of pulling the strings. Start from the absolute bottom, running shows in dingy local gyms, and scrape your way up the ladder to become the premier wrestling promotion in the world. It takes a fistful of cash, shrewd business tactics, and an eye for talent to pack a 100,000-seat stadium. Do you have what it takes to survive the grind?

3-Year Promoter Mode: Define an Era You have exactly three years to turn a struggling indie fed into a global wrestling powerhouse. Every week counts, every dollar matters, and every booking decision shapes your legacy. Can you define an era of professional wrestling before your time is up?

Win the Ratings War It’s not just about putting on a good show; it’s about crushing the competition. Compete directly against a ruthless rival promotion. Fight for viewership dominance, steal their momentum, and win the ratings war to secure your spot at the top of the industry.

Global Network Connect with the community and bridge the gap between the game and the real world. Put your wrestling knowledge to the test by predicting the outcomes of real-world Pay-Per-View events to earn exclusive in-game rewards and boost your promotion.

Build Your Roster Scout, hire, and manage a diverse roster of professional wrestlers. Every athlete has their own stats, drawing power, and ego. Will you build a company around established, expensive veterans, or take a risk on cheap, unknown indie darlings and mold them into megastars?

Ruthless Tycoon Mechanics Wrestling is an art, but it's also a cutthroat business.

  • Manage Finances: Balance the books. Pay your talent, rent out larger venues, and invest in marketing, lighting, and better production values.

  • Handle Backstage Drama: Egos will clash. It’s up to you to manage locker room morale, deal with injuries, and keep your top stars happy before they jump ship to the rival promotion.

store_data.about_the_game:
A world where one click produces art that would have taken a week.

EULA is a visual novel that asks what 【 drawing , what 【 creation 】, means in this age of AI.


◆ Core System ◆

Same story. Different perspectives.

Press 【 Tab 】 at any time to switch modes.

Just as people see the same event differently,

each mode casts the story in a different light.

At the moment your convictions waver, the story 【 branches 】 according to your perspective.

Organic Mode | Art, writing, and music made by human hands.

AI Mode | Art, writing, and music generated by algorithm.

The choice you make when the story 【 branches 】 cannot be undone.

It is not just 【 what you see 】. It is a difference in 【 how you see the world 】.

◆ Story ◆

June 2026. A world barely different from our own.

You are an unknown illustrator in your early twenties. You've been honing your skills, building your portfolio.

You love it so much you skip meals, too absorbed to notice your hands going numb.

Out of nowhere, image-generation AI appears - producing art better than yours in seconds.

A friend recommends an AI art generation service to you - 【 HumbleAI 】.

「 Just for reference... the composition... right?」

The 【 choice 】 is yours.

Do you agree to the use of AI-generated content?

◆ A Story That Changes ◆

A choice splits the story.

Will you 【 agree 】, or will you 【 refuse 】.

Can you hold that 【 choice 】 to the very end.

What if you never once change your 【 conviction 】?

【 This story is not fiction. It is ours. 】

store_data.about_the_game:
Start young. Think long term. Chase the top.

Follow the journey of a 10-year-old boy chasing his football dream.

Starting from the bottom - the 3rd league - he must train, improve, and help his team rise.

The road is full of choices: Which skills should he develop first? Who will stand by his side? And will he rise high enough to reach the 1st league and represent his country?

The game is designed to show a footballer’s development over time in a simple, clear, and engaging way.

You wake up with a dream: play at the highest level.

MyFootballGrowthStory follows that dream from your first youth training session to high-stakes national competition.

You begin as a kid in a class of 16 newcomers. Choose your player, shape your club, and push through day-by-day training built around cards, drills, and match preparation. Every season is a test of planning, consistency, and pressure performance.

Your path moves across four seasons:

- Early league seasons where you must climb and prove yourself

- A final national stage with group rounds and knockout matches

You grow through a Pwr skill tree that changes how quickly you develop, how efficiently you train, and how much control you have over each run.

Not every season ends in glory. If you fall short, special mechanic pull you back into a new attempt with long-term carry-over, giving you another shot at the dream.

Key Features:

- Story-driven single-player football journey

- Start at age 10 and progress across 4 seasons

- Choose your main player from 16 youth players

- Card-based training and 7v7 match simulation

- League progression, then national tournament structure

- Pwr skill tree with unlockable upgrades

- Replay loop and alternate outcomes

- Persistent save/continue progression

store_data.about_the_game:
"Hero & Monster" is a strategy game that blends auto-chess lineup building with real-time combat. You must carefully manage your resources in the shop between waves to forge an invincible army.

37 Recruitable Units
Spanning 5 tiers, from cheap Skeletons to the mighty Grim Reaper, each unit has a unique passive ability. Combine six faction synergies to build your own legion.

17 Active Spells
Arcane Barrage, Frost Prison, Meteor Shower, Undead Recall… Cast spells in real time on the battlefield to turn the tide of battle.

11 Unique Heroes
Light Priestess, Frost General, Shadow Assassin… Each hero has a unique passive talent, exclusive skill, and starting spell, offering distinctly different combat styles.

6 Major Synergies
Emerald Watch, Iron Blood Warband, Shadow Hunter Group, Arcane Coven, Holy Soul Covenant… — cleverly match factions to trigger powerful synergy effects and multiply your army’s strength.

3 Difficulty Levels
30 waves of enemies across three difficulty settings, from Normal to Brutal, putting your strategic limits to the test.

Deep Shop Economy
Buy units and learn spells in the shop between waves. Manage gold interest, adjust unit order, and weigh short-term power against long-term growth — every single coin matters.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the wasteland after the collapse of civilization, cities lie like islands at the ends of broken rail lines. As the conductor, you will command an ever-expanding mobile base, travel between survivor settlements, haul vital supplies, make a living through trade, and protect the last lifeline of civilization against monsters, broken tracks, and extreme weather.

Your Train Is Your Base

Install cargo, combat, research, training, and living facilities within limited carriage space. Assign crew roles and balance transport capacity, defense, production, morale, and growth. Every expansion and layout change will directly affect the efficiency and risk of the next journey.

Trade, Supplies, and Route Decisions

Each city has its own stock, demand, and price fluctuations. Filling every slot with high-value goods means carrying less ammunition, repair parts, and daily necessities. The choice between shorter but more dangerous main lines and longer but safer side routes is yours.

Real-Time Combat and Track Repair Defense

Enemies can pursue your train while it is moving, and they can also launch full assaults when you stop to repair damaged tracks. Configure train-mounted weapons, deploy engineers and fighters, and protect key carriages and the workers repairing the rails if you want to keep moving.

Train Your Crew and Unlock Crystal-Core Technology

Survivors have different attributes and responsibilities. Improve your team's capabilities through training, research, and carriage facilities. Recover crystal cores from monsters to develop weapons, shields, and special techniques, and gradually turn your train into a true steel fortress.

Close In on the Truth Across the Wasteland Rails

Explore unknown towns and branching routes, retake lost settlements, complete contracts, build reputation, and investigate the source of the catastrophe across an ever-expanding rail network. Every departure may bring back resources, companions, technology, or new scars.

store_data.about_the_game:
Lenos is a top-down co-op dungeon crawler where you and up to 3 friends loot, shoot, and fight your way through procedurally generated dungeons — then race to extract before it's too late.

Gear Up. Dive In. Get Out Alive.

Every run drops you into a randomized dungeon filled with enemies, loot, and secrets. Scavenge weapons, attachments, and supplies. Build your loadout on the fly. When the extraction bell rings, you have 60 seconds to reach the exit — or lose everything.

Key Features

7 Unique Dungeons Explore a haunted school, frozen tundra, abandoned factory, underground catacombs, research lab, subway tunnels, and deep mines. Each dungeon is procedurally generated with randomized layouts, enemy spawns, and loot placement — no two runs are the same.

Deep Weapon & Build System Wield firearms from pistols to flamethrowers, or go melee with bats, maces, and sledgehammers. Attach suppressors, scopes, and grips to fine-tune your arsenal. Discover hidden weapon evolutions by meeting specific attachment and perk conditions.

Perk Synergies Stack and combine over 50 perks across 6 rarity tiers. Pair the right perks together to automatically unlock powerful Synergy perks — Explosive Rounds + Ricochet = Fireworks. Iron Fist + Adrenaline Rush = Berserker. Experiment to find devastating combos.

5 Active Skills & Full Skill Tree Choose from Power Shot, Spike Trap, Barrier, Hook Shot, and EMP Burst. Invest skill points across 35+ nodes in Combat, Survival, Utility, and Mobility branches to shape your playstyle.

4-Player Online Co-op Team up via Steam P2P networking. Revive downed teammates, share callouts through built-in proximity voice chat, and coordinate extractions under pressure. Enemy difficulty scales with your party size.

Permanent Progression Level up to 75 across runs. Unlock perks, invest in your skill tree, and earn cosmetic rewards. Complete 30 challenges — from speedruns to no-damage boss kills — to prove your mastery and unlock hats, glow effects, and more.

3 Difficulty Tiers Start on Easy, push through Normal, and unlock Hard mode where enemies hit harder, move faster, and spawn relentlessly. Chase 3-star ratings on every dungeon and difficulty.

Crafting & Looting Break down salvage into raw materials. Craft bandages, medkits, grenades, revival kits, weapons, and armor at any time. Manage your limited inventory — or find a better backpack.

Fight Smart or Die Fast

Enemies don't just chase you. Zombie squads coordinate with flanking, pinning, and rushing tactics. Ghosts phase through walls. Bombers detonate on contact. Necromancers raise the dead. And when the boss arrives — every mistake counts.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your father is dead. His apartment must be cleared.

Years after leaving your childhood home behind, you return to the old apartment building for one final task: empty Benjamin’s apartment on the 9th floor. But once you step inside, your phone begins receiving messages from him.

The elevator becomes your only safe place. Every floor opens into a different part of the building’s memory: maintenance rooms, locked service areas, distorted corridors, and places that should not exist inside an apartment block.

To reach the 9th floor, you must restore the elevator system, recover missing service parts, and complete the final reboot. But the building does not simply ask for repairs. Each floor forces you through something personal.

A home that rejects you.
A caretaker that demands obedience.
A signal that carries messages from the dead.
A ward that tries to classify who you are.

And above it all, Benjamin is waiting.

Features

Elevator-as-safe-zone horror:
The elevator is the only place that feels safe. Every time the doors open, you decide whether to step out into another floor or stay inside a little longer.

A personal psychological horror story:
Return to your late father’s apartment and face a building shaped by memory, guilt, family, and identity.

Distorted floors with unique gameplay:
Each floor has its own psychological sequence, from maintenance puzzles and service panels to liminal corridors, false homes, and classification tests.

Phone messages from Benjamin:
Your father is dead, but his messages keep arriving. Some guide you. Some accuse you. Some should not be possible.

Compact, focused experience:
A short, atmospheric horror game built around exploration, tension, and a clear goal: reach the 9th floor.

Gameplay Loop

Read building notices, old messages, and maintenance notes.

Search the building for access routes and service keys.

Recover missing elevator parts: fuse, cable, presence sensor, utility access, and reboot code.

Return to the elevator service system and restore the missing functions.

Complete the reboot sequence.

Reach Floor 9 and enter Benjamin’s apartment.

Restore the elevator. Reach the 9th floor.

store_data.about_the_game:
Introduction

Do you have a favorite character?

Picking the one that speaks to you, going on adventures together, having conversations — that's one of the best parts of any game.

But have you ever wondered: what happens to the characters who never got to be your favorite? How do they feel during all that time you weren't there? When you next open the game, do you really think they'll greet you with a smile — just like your favorite always does?

LUNADUN: LUNATIC DUNGEON is an adventure game built around that very question. Your choices determine the fate of every character.

Characters

Galuo "Your Childhood Friend" / "The Childhood Friend Someone Wanted"

A hotheaded young man who charges headlong into a dangerous dungeon, driven by a single-minded desire to save a mutual friend. Beneath the surface, however, he is slowly consumed by the compulsion that he must never stop living up to everyone's expectations.

Albie "An Ordinary Scout" / "A Scout Who Could Never Be Special"

A earnest young man who joins the party despite his doubts about the mission. Neglected by his father in childhood, he came to believe he has no worth of his own — and has held himself together ever since by making himself replaceable.

Megalis "A Wandering Monster" / "A Monster Who Survived Anyway"

A mysterious monster woman who leads a caravan. She has endured the harshest of conditions — stripped of dignity, armed with nothing but her wits. Even the tragedies she has suffered, she claims, are no one's fault but her own.

Mamakona "The Daughter of Fate"

A childhood friend waiting for you at the end of a long journey, at the very edge of the story. What meaning will her presence bring to all the choices and responsibilities you've accumulated along the way…?

You

You, in this game. A fleeting form, stripped of everything.

――Their fates are mirror images of each other. One person's salvation is another person's ruin.

"The ones you showed kindness to, the ones you turned away — you don't get to walk away from any of them."

Key Features

  • Inescapable Paired Fates The game features an affection system driven by your choices. But raising one character's affection will always, inevitably, lower another's. Salvation and ruin come as a pair — there is no comfortable middle ground.

  • Four Characters Four characters, each carrying their own grief and loneliness (one of whom will be added in a major update). They are not mere data — they are living individuals whose fates will be transformed by the choices you make.

  • The Weight of Every Choice Every click saves someone's future and destroys another's. Through the multi-ending system, players will be held — in the most literal sense — responsible for the consequences of their choices.

A Note on Translation

The developer is Japanese, and Japanese is their first language. All languages other than Japanese are currently AI-translated. If anything feels off or incorrect, please let us know on Discord! (You're also welcome to join the LUNADUN Community Translation Project.)

We'd love to have you as part of the LUNADUN team!

Content Warning

This game contains content that some players may find disturbing or uncomfortable.

If any of the following themes are difficult for you, please use your own discretion before playing.

  • Violence

  • Self-harm

  • Violence and neglect toward children

  • Discrimination and exclusion toward Monsters (fictional beings)

Estimated Playtime (Early Access)

  • Average playtime per run: approx. 90 minutes

  • Meet certain conditions and you can unlock both the salvation and ruin endings in a single run

  • Full ending completion: approx. 270–360 minutes

Development Roadmap

  • Late 2026: Early Access (main story)

  • Early 2027: Major Update ("True Ending" added)

store_data.about_the_game:
In Sheep Game: Something In The Flock, your job is simple: feed the sheep daily and make sure everything is accounted for before night falls. But each day, more sheep arrive, and not all of them are normal. Some are impostors—shape-shifters pretending to be normal sheep.

Watch the field, verify your counts, and hunt down the impostor sheep before they grow in number. The longer they stay hidden, the more dangerous things become. Keep the real sheep alive, survive the days, and figure out what is hiding among your flock.

Take Care of your Sheep

Sheep Game: Something In The Flock is a horror ranch game where your job sounds simple: take care of the sheep, keep the flock alive, and survive whatever is hiding among them

Pet the sheep, watch them wander around the ranch, and try to keep everything under control as the flock grows larger each day.

Defend the Ranch!

Not every sheep is actually a sheep.

Shapeshifters and skinwalkers will try to blend in with the flock, waiting for the right moment to strike. Watch their behavior, listen for strange sounds, and hunt down the impostors before they get too dangerous.

They will be watching and waiting for an opportunity to strike

Many Ways To Play

When you’re not dealing with monsters in sheep’s clothing, you can spend time around the ranch, goof off, explore, and mess with the sheep.

Or you can completely ignore sleep, run around in total darkness at 3 AM, and make everything worse.
Either way, there is always something to do on the ranch.

Features

  • Care for a growing flock of sheep

  • Feed sheep and refill water bins

  • Watch for imposter sheep hiding in the flock

  • Defend the ranch from shapeshifters and Skinwalkers

  • Survive increasingly dangerous nights

  • Pet sheep, explore the ranch, and mess around between tasks

  • An in-depth weather system and fog each day

As the Overseer, survey a miniature world and try to detect the suspicious movement patterns and actions that betray which of the little creatures are controlled by the flat screen players. And then, use your eye laser to take them down!

store_data.about_the_game:
Chronicles Puzzle: A Journey Through History

Pause for a moment. Do you hear that silence? That is the universe just before the Big Bang. And you are right there.

As an independent developer, I created this game with a single goal: to take you on a journey that you won't experience in everyday life. In Chronicles Puzzle: A Journey Through History, you aren't just a player sliding tiles across a screen. You are a silent witness to billions of years of our existence.

⏳ Your Journey Through Time

Imagine holding the very shards of time in your hands. All of history has shattered, and your task is to piece it back together, bit by bit, to restore the world to its true form. 80 unique levels await you, which—thanks to optional difficulties—transform into an incredible 320 challenges for your perception and mind.

Your pilgrimage is divided into pivotal epochs that shaped everything we know:

  • The Birth of All Being: Witness the moment the Big Bang erupted from silence and darkness. Feel the heat of the first stars and see the chaos from which our Earth was born.

  • The Age of Giants: Walk through the dangerous landscapes of prehistory. Stand face-to-face with dinosaurs and feel the raw power of nature in its purest form.

  • The Rise of Humanity: Follow the fascinating evolution of man. From the first tools through famous historical eras to the bustling present, where the history we remember was written.

  • Beyond Today: Where will science, our dreams, and our desire for knowledge lead us? Assemble your own vision of the near future, where the boundaries of the possible vanish into the distance.

🏛️ Uncover Hidden Testimonies

The storyline is just the beginning. As you successfully traverse through time, you will unlock rare chapters carefully hidden behind the curtain of history. Gradually, you will reveal the majestic Wonders of the World, bring breathtaking prehistoric creatures back to life, and peek behind the scenes of groundbreaking discoveries. But be prepared—history guards its greatest secrets closely and won't show them to everyone right away.

🧩 Find Your Own Rhythm

I know that everyone experiences stories differently. That’s why the game fully adapts to your mood:

  • Need peace? In Relax Mode, time does not exist. Just you, beautiful music, and the pure joy of a completed image.

  • Up for a challenge? Test your reflexes in three timed difficulty levels. Can you save history before the limit expires?

  • Choose your depth: Each puzzle offers 4 levels of grid complexity: 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, or 6x6.

🏆 Your Collection of Knowledge and Success

For your skill, you will earn stars and royal crowns. These won’t just open further chapters, but an entire Hall of Fame. Collect medals, trophies, and complete Steam Achievements as proof that you have mastered history to perfection.

⚡ Strategic Bonuses

When the path seems too difficult, you can use in-game credits earned during play to call upon special bonuses:

Chronicles Puzzle: A Journey Through History

Pause for a moment. Do you hear that silence? That is the universe just before the Big Bang. And you are right there.

As an independent developer, I created this game with a single goal: to take you on a journey that you won't experience in everyday life. In Chronicles Puzzle: A Journey Through History, you aren't just a player sliding tiles across a screen. You are a silent witness to billions of years of our existence.

⏳ Your Journey Through Time

Imagine holding the very shards of time in your hands. All of history has shattered, and your task is to piece it back together, bit by bit, to restore the world to its true form. 80 unique levels await you, which—thanks to optional difficulties—transform into an incredible 320 challenges for your perception and mind.

Your pilgrimage is divided into pivotal epochs that shaped everything we know:

  • The Birth of All Being: Witness the moment the Big Bang erupted from silence and darkness. Feel the heat of the first stars and see the chaos from which our Earth was born.

  • The Age of Giants: Walk through the dangerous landscapes of prehistory. Stand face-to-face with dinosaurs and feel the raw power of nature in its purest form.

  • The Rise of Humanity: Follow the fascinating evolution of man. From the first tools through famous historical eras to the bustling present, where the history we remember was written.

  • Beyond Today: Where will science, our dreams, and our desire for knowledge lead us? Assemble your own vision of the near future, where the boundaries of the possible vanish into the distance.

🏛️ Uncover Hidden Testimonies

The storyline is just the beginning. As you successfully traverse through time, you will unlock rare chapters carefully hidden behind the curtain of history. Gradually, you will reveal the majestic Wonders of the World, bring breathtaking prehistoric creatures back to life, and peek behind the scenes of groundbreaking discoveries. But be prepared—history guards its greatest secrets closely and won't show them to everyone right away.

🧩 Find Your Own Rhythm

I know that everyone experiences stories differently. That’s why the game fully adapts to your mood:

  • Need peace? In Relax Mode, time does not exist. Just you, beautiful music, and the pure joy of a completed image.

  • Up for a challenge? Test your reflexes in three timed difficulty levels. Can you save history before the limit expires?

  • Choose your depth: Each puzzle offers 4 levels of grid complexity: 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, or 6x6.

🏆 Your Collection of Knowledge and Success

For your skill, you will earn stars and royal crowns. These won’t just open further chapters, but an entire Hall of Fame. Collect medals, trophies, and complete Steam Achievements as proof that you have mastered history to perfection.

⚡ Strategic Bonuses

When the path seems too difficult, you can use in-game credits earned during play to call upon special bonuses:

  • Swap: Magically swap any two tiles exactly as you need.

  • Numbers: Numbers the pieces for a limited time for better orientation.

  • View: Momentarily reveals the final image in all its glory.

store_data.about_the_game:
What to Expect

  • Romance plot with one and only ML (male lead).

  • A defined female character with her own personality and backstory.

  • Murder mystery in a Dark Academia setting.

  • Choices that matter—decide how our heroine interacts with the world and how the story ends.

  • No fail states or bad endings—all routes and endings are canonical and satisfying.

  • Gorgeous 2.5D indoor and outdoor environments.

  • Mature content: suggestive romantic illustrations and descriptions of sexual foreplay known as "closed-door" spice for romance readers (no visual nudity or explicit artwork).

  • Depictions of food (such as cupcakes and pancakes) that can make you crave sweets, strong coffee, and men who can cook.

About a week after the funeral, Magister Ignas Rottenheart is nowhere near getting over the tragic death of his coworker. With the murderer still at large, an accusation pinned on him by authorities, and no way to investigate on his own… he turns to forbidden arts and summons a creature from The Ashes.

Which happens to be you. The man names you Blanca Silverurn, makes you pretend to be human, and act as his assistant. In reality, you are his eyes and ears at the University, searching for clues and suspects.

With the ability to talk in your head, Ignas shares his perception of the world with you. Ordering you around, he's testing your patience and self-control. Relying on each other will be hard for both sides, especially when you find out your goals may be clashing.

Will you become his salvation, his doom… or both?

Exploring the city of Grimstrand and its university campus, you will meet 12 unique and complex characters with their own little secrets and goings-on. Whether you choose to meddle with them or focus on dealing with your own problems will affect their fates.

As lovely as our cast may seem, remember that there's a killer among them! It's going to be your call to point out the perpetrator.

You will encounter them while sightseeing over 10 atmospheric locations—the outdoor ones being in their full autumnal glory—so be sure to pay attention to all the details.

Magic manifests in the form of ever-present, glittering fog and causes a strange illness in its users, who call themselves Incante. They can look into the past and research the secrets of the supernatural using gemstones.

For scholars who prefer to keep away from The Ashes, there are other paths to pursue—the Domain of Solution (alchemists) and the Domain of Divine (a religious group trying to predict the future).

There's a lot more to discover for seasoned lore hunters, but a healthy amount of open-mindedness is advised.*

*"Strix and Scholar" is set in a fictional world. Its architecture is inspired by old European cities (Kraków, Prague, Paris, Cambridge—to name a few). Culturally, it's an almost modern (with a pinch of a liberal take on 20th-century Europe) society. All places, people, fashion, items, and language used by the characters are not supposed to be historically accurate.

In 2025, a creative married couple decided to take the artistic pseudonym TJ Hoarfrost and formed a game studio under the same name. Combining their passions and skills—hers being storytelling and his being visual arts and programming—they were bent on cooking a game straight from the depths of their hearts.

Turns out it's "Strix and Scholar"—an interactive narrative experience unapologetically catered to groups such as:

  • Romantasy/Mystery Romance/Urban Fantasy/Dark Academia book readers who are also gamers.

  • "Choose your own adventure" lovers looking for new, exciting hooks and settings.

  • RPG fans who play for the story, characters, vibes, and the "role-playing" part rather than combat.

  • Dating-sim players who may be tired of the "quantity over quality" approach to romance and would appreciate having one deep, well-developed relationship arc to follow and influence.

store_data.about_the_game:
Take a solo journey to Shanghai and wander through its streets and alleys, capturing slices of everyday life through your lens. Drift between parks and lane houses, pause at busy street corners, and observe fleeting, unguarded moments. Discover the city's many small stories—funny, lively, awkward, and heartwarming—hidden in the quiet details of daily life.

Small Life: Shanghai is a relaxing hidden-object game that blends exploration with light narrative elements. Each scene draws inspiration from different corners of Shanghai—roadside shops, neighborhood parks, bustling intersections—with every location telling its own story. Search for carefully hidden details, discover two unique story triggers in each scene, and record your findings in your journal as you piece together fragments of the city’s memories.

With no time limits or pressure, the game invites you to explore at your own pace. Observe, discover, and reflect as you experience the rhythm of the city and uncover the quiet beauty of everyday life.

Features

  • Hand-drawn line art style that captures the intricate details of urban life

  • Authentic Shanghai-inspired locations that bring the city's distinctive atmosphere to life

  • Heartwarming everyday moments that reveal the subtle connections between people

Reading for the dead.

TD Master

TD Master is a tactical tower defense game built around strategy, systems, and control. Build your defenses, optimize your layout, and adapt to increasingly dangerous enemy waves.

Every placement matters. Every upgrade counts.

Plan, Build, Defend

Design your battlefield using a variety of traps and defensive tools. Success comes from smart placement, efficient layouts, and adapting your strategy as the match evolves.

  • Grid-based building and tactical placement

  • Multiple trap types with unique behaviors

  • Optimize layouts for damage, control, and efficiency

  • React to changing threats as waves intensify

(trap inspections)

Upgrade and Adapt

Strengthen your defenses throughout each run by investing in the traps and systems that match your playstyle.

  • Upgrade traps for higher damage and better efficiency

  • Manage your resources carefully

  • Balance offense, defense, and economy

  • Expand your setup as the battlefield grows more demanding

(lightning chain lighting trap)

Survive the Waves

Enemy pressure increases over time, forcing you to refine your build and respond to new challenges before your defenses collapse.

  • Escalating wave difficulty

  • Varied enemy behaviors and combat pressure

  • Boss encounters that test your setup

  • Reactive gameplay where poor planning gets punished

(Ballista trap)

Analyze and Improve

Use detailed match data to understand your performance, compare builds, and improve your strategy over time.

  • Track damage, efficiency, and outcomes

  • Identify your strongest setups

  • Refine your tactics using gameplay data

No two runs play out exactly the same. Experiment with new builds, optimize your approach, and push for better results each time.

  • Experiment with different layouts and trap combinations

  • Optimize your performance across repeated runs

  • Improve through strategy, iteration, and mastery

(Rollers floor trap)

Built for PC

TD Master is designed for clear, responsive gameplay with a focus on readable information and precise control.

  • Smooth building and placement systems

  • Responsive mouse and keyboard controls

store_data.about_the_game:
In the grim darkness of the 69th Millennium, even the Emperor's finest need to take a break.

FUTAHAMMER 69000 is a laid-back, low-stress arcade brick-breaker set in a sci-fi universe where the galaxy's fiercest warriors bring their own "heavy artillery" to the party. The crusades are exhausting, the warp is loud, and sometimes a Commander just needs to kick back, turn up the music, and admire the local... scenery.

We aren’t going to pretend this is a highly complex, sweaty tactical simulator. This is a game designed purely for relaxation. We’ve paired simple, satisfying brick-breaking mechanics with an absolutely killer soundtrack. Your only mission is to clear the heretical blocks, vibe to the music, and unlock highly classified, explicit encounters featuring the fully-loaded women of the Holy Vanguard.

⚔️ R&R (Rest & Relaxation) Features:

  • The Holy Playlist: The real star of the show. Kick back to a fantastic, player-praised soundtrack that goes way harder than a simple arcade game has any right to. Put your headphones on and let the stress of the galaxy melt away.

  • Lazy Arcade Action: Classic, zero-stress brick-breaking. No complicated skill trees, no punishing difficulty spikes. Just bounce your Holy Orb, break the blocks, and enjoy the show.

  • Superior Firepower: As you clear the stages, you'll unlock explicit, high-quality, uncensored scenes (Futa x Girl and Futa x Futa). These warriors are packing massive payloads, and they are ready to help you unwind.

  • The Golden Archives: A gallery mode fit for a Lord Commander on leave. Replay your unlocked conquests and admire their "extra equipment" at your leisure.

  • One-Handed Command: Play with just your mouse. Keep one hand on the paddle and the other free for... whatever relaxes you.

The galaxy can wait. Turn up the volume, drop your armor, and enjoy the view.

store_data.about_the_game:
Every argument begins with set of premises that, if true, necessitate some conclusion. Your task is to prove that the conclusion does indeed follow.

Given a set of premises, apply rules of inference and replacement to derive new propositions — step by step — until you reach the conclusion. Each level is a proof waiting to be completed.

As a newly aware intelligence, each proof explores themes of being and essence, virtue, the soul, causality, and the pursuit of truth. Simply put, you are a mind reasoning its way from first principles toward understanding.

Features

  • 120+ handcrafted levels spanning propositional logic and predicate calculus, levels varying both thematically and mechanically

  • 23 rules of logic — 7 rules of inference (Modus Ponens, Modus Tollens, Hypothetical Syllogism, and more), 11 rules of replacement (Double Negation, De Morgan's Laws, Transposition, and more), and 5 quantifier rules (Universal/Existential Instantiation and Generalization, Quantifier Negation)

  • Gentle learning curve — 18 tutorial levels introduce one rule at a time, building from simple one-step proofs to multi-step chains

  • Deep complexity — later levels feature nested quantifiers, multi-variable domains, and proofs requiring 10+ derivation steps

  • Intuitive drag-and-drop interface — slot propositions into rules, see the result, and build your proof step by step

  • Par system — every level has an optimal solution length; can you find the shortest proof?

  • No time pressure — think as long as you need; every proof waits for you

  • 60+ Steam achievements — milestones, rule mastery challenges, and hidden achievements for completionists

  • Cloud saves — pick up where you left off on any machine

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

MOVILLIA is a gripping underground survival adventure set in a world where Earth as we know it has changed beyond recognition. Explore scientifically grounded biomes, utilize futuristic technologies, and uncover the mystery of a planet that has become alien to humanity.

                                           

Return to Survive

You are part of an expedition sent to Earth years after a massive meteor strike. Your goal: to study how our home has transformed. But a landing incident drags your group deep into the planet's interior. Cut off from the surface, with no map and no hope for quick rescue, you must navigate the entire ecosystem of the "New Earth" to find a way out.

                                           

Scientific Research and Crafting

In MOVILLIA, exploration isn't just a stroll - it's the key to survival.

  • Smart Scanner: Study flora and fauna. Your AI assistant will build hypotheses by comparing new chemical compounds and shell structures with old terrestrial data.

  • Adaptive Crafting: All scanned data turns into blueprints. Collect alien resources to create the tools necessary for deeper descent.

                                               

Tools of the Future

Darkness and anomalies require non-standard solutions:

  • LiDAR: When a flare might attract predators, scan the space with pulses. LiDAR builds a point cloud in real-time, allowing you to see through fog and darkness without revealing your location with light.

  • Grappling Hook: Manage inertia and move freely through massive halls.

  • Drill and Ice Axe: Mine rare ores and defend yourself against giant bats lurking in the shadows.

  • Transport: Try to tame local creatures to cover vast distances.

                                               

Predators: Senses Over Sight

The cave ecosystem has adapted to darkness, and you must do the same.

  • Hearing: Some creatures react to your every step. Use sound decoys or throw stones to distract them.

  • Smell: Hide in pungent puddles or use gas canisters to throw pursuers off your scent.

  • Vibration: If the ground shakes beneath a predator's feet - freeze or use your grappling hook to stay off the floor.

                                               

The Atmosphere of New Earth

Travel through mesmerizing and dangerous biomes:

  • Bioluminescent Gardens: Fields of glowing spores and giant mushrooms.

  • Crystal Halls: Caves with skyscraper-sized crystals that shift the physics of light.

  • Gas Lakes: Zones with altered gravity and resin traps.

  • Magma Rifts: Fiery depths where Earth's core power meets alien radiation.

Uncover the Survivors' Secret Earth was not empty. Find the traces of those who couldn't escape. What happened to the people trapped on a dying planet? Decode the hierarchy of this new life and find a way out of this beautiful nightmare.

                                                                                                                                  

About the Developer

I am a solo indie developer creating this project alone. I am 20 years old and a university student. Besides gamedev, I produce music and have a passion for scientific disciplines.

MOVILLIA is my take on sci-fi survival. The idea is based on the real-life Movile Cave in Romania - an isolated ecosystem that existed for millions of years without sunlight, hosting dozens of unknown species through chemosynthesis. I wanted to bring the concept of such a unique, closed environment to life on a massive scale. That’s how this project was born.

store_data.about_the_game:
🌱🔨 A fresh take on the classic farming sim! 🌽⛏️

You have been commissioned to restore the ancient dwarven halls, which long ago fell into ruin. The Dwarf King will return in just a few short weeks to assess your progress. Be strategic and diligent, lest you fail to meet his lofty standards...

🗺️ EXPEDITIONS

Day in and day out, manage your time wisely to improve your city across three important categories: Artistry, Community, and Economy.

  • Craft powerful items & restore broken infrastructure to improve Artistry;

  • Make friends, complete requests, cook recipes, & visit the tavern to improve Community;

  • Produce & ship valuable items to improve Economy.

Will the Dwarf King be proud of what you accomplish, or will he scorn your idleness when he returns..?

🎮 MODERN FEATURES, RETRO SENSIBILITIES

Never refill a watering can, micro-manage a stamina bar, or pass out at midnight again! We've also added modern accessibility options: rate of time options, quick-fishing, save from anywhere, an auto-run toggle, control rebinding, and an adjustable game difficulty setting.

💎 CROPS & CRYSTALS

There's a city of hard-working dwarves to feed, so farming is important work! Get to know both types of fields.

  • Underground fields are great for growing a wide variety of mushrooms, a favorite food of many dwarves; clearing will provide you with useful Minerals.

  • Outdoor fields, found up above the city in the mountainsides, are perfect for growing traditional crops: vegetables, grains, fruits, and more. Clearing will provide you with plentiful Lumber.

You will be richly rewarded at harvest if you tend to your crops well. Sell your products or use them to make one of 70+ delicious dwarven recipes at the cooking-hearth.

The dwarves have also mastered the arcane art of Crystal-growing! Refine your minerals into crystal solutions, then add them to a pool of enchanted water. Watch as a gorgeous crystal grows before your eyes in just a few short days!

  • Once fully grown, a crystal is a very valuable item that can be sold for a small fortune; or, combine its magical properties with other ingredients to craft enchanted tools & items at the anvil.

🏛️ WORKS OF AWE & WONDER

Raise your hammer and strike the anvil!

Collect resources throughout the world, such as minerals, ores, and lumber. Then combine them at the anvil to improve your tools or create new works of quality!

Complete Works Projects on behalf of the city: restore broken statues & pillars, repair caved-in tunnels, and rebuild broken stairways. Many Works Projects provide you with a benefit upon completion, and the Dwarf King will surely smile upon your handiwork.

🧙‍♂️ MAKE FRIENDS

Get to know your fellow Expeditionary dwarves!

  • Chat & give gifts daily to make new friends. Each dwarf has their own weekly schedule and item preferences, so pay attention if you want to make the most of your efforts!

  • Complete Requests by cooking favored recipes or delivering rare items.

  • After a hard day's work, stop by the local tavern for a refreshing beverage; many dwarves gather here to socialize, and you'll get special perks & bonuses for dropping in.

🐏 BOUNTIFUL BEASTS

Raise livestock in your underground barn.

  • Quails lay eggs;

  • Goats provide milk;

  • Glow-grubs spin enchanted silk;

  • and Wyrmlings shed valuable scales.

Take good care of your animals, letting them out to the pasture when the weather is nice. Healthy animals provide daily products and can multiply through breeding.

🌿 FISHING & FORAGING

Explore the world to find useful ingredients! Discover wild herbs that grow upon the mountain-slopes; extract honey from the beehive; or go fishing in a pond or river.

Sell, cook, or gift what you collect.

🛡️ CARVE YOUR LEGACY

Though your Expedition may come to an end, the impact of your deeds will carry on...

  • Customize a unique player-character, choosing from hundreds of style & color options.

  • Pick one of five dwarf Kindreds to belong to; each has unique perks that will assist you in your Expedition.

  • When your Expedition ends, you will be rewarded based on how well you met the Dwarf King's requirements; bring these perks & benefits with you into your future runs, playing as your own successor.

For the glory of the Five Kindreds!

For the glory of the Five Kindreds!

store_data.about_the_game:
You were swallowed by the tentacled creature... but instead of becoming another victim YOU TOOK CONTROL!

Now the eldritch mass obeys you. Your body is still lost somewhere in the depths, but with the help of your brilliant (and curiously eager) elf researcher girlfriend, you might just claw your way back to freedom.

Core Gameplay

  • Click to harvest neurons and grow your tentacle dominion

  • Upgrade tentacles with roguelite-inspired card choices

  • Face walls that force prestiges ("Attempt to Escape") to reset and gain tokens for unlocking new scenes!

  • Evolve mechanics with run-meta cards: crits that spawn Hearts, rerolls, and more!

Every run is a bit different. Pick from 3 (or 4) upgrade cards each level - classic upgrades clash with opportunity costs.

The Erotic Twist  - Your elf companion isn't just helping out of kindness. She's fascinated by your new abilities... and wants to study them up close. Progress unlocks her increasingly intimate "research" sessions, heart-pounding encounters, and tentacle-driven fantasies. "It's still you in there, so it's not cheating, right?"

Collect Hearts and Brains and access the Gallery - a collection of animated scenes. Each entry costs more than the last, but you choose the unlock order. Packs form mini narrative arcs.

Features

  • Semi-roguelite progression with run-permanent meta unlocks

  • Narrative woven through intro, a few prestige milestones, gallery unlocks, and ending

  • Inverse scaling: faster Hearts at higher levels, but harder to gain new levels - do you prestige or count on your luck for a rare card that gives extra Brain token?

  • Try to escape until the Gallery is complete and have your happy ever after!

            ... Or just unlock the entire gallery to view scenes with a cheat code and don't bother with clicking.

  • Adult content focused on tentacle themes, power dynamics, consensual exploration, and body-altering pleasure

  • Roughly 3-4 hours of playtime, maybe more, maybe less, depending on your luck and strategy

Can you escape and reclaim your humanity? Or will the tentacles claim you forever?

Tentacle Master is a blend of idle clicking, roguelite choices, and erotic storytelling. Perfect for fans of cozy incremental games with a mature, narrative-driven edge.

store_data.about_the_game:
Penguin Pirates is a chaotic sailing party game where you catch the wind and shoot your cannons at the same time. Collect power-ups, dodge sharks, and sink your friends to prove you are the best pirate ever, arrr!


Take the helm - It's the golden age of penguin piracy

Get your ship ready, pull the ropes and sail! Enjoy the wind physics and master the angles to speed up, or drop the sails to get the most out of your boat.

Collect powerups

Becoming a ghost, getting flamethrowers, dropping an unexpected rock, or suddenly changing the wind direction - everything can become useful in the right moment.

Avoid obstacles

There are islands on your course, treacherous icebergs, and bloodthirsty sharks. Avoiding a crash will require extra skill when your friends' boats come into sight.

Challenge your friends

All in all, only one penguin can claim the title of the best pirate. Race your friends in a regatta, outshine them in plundering, or simply start a naval battle and sink them all!

Overview

  • A sailing party game with simple rules but deep gameplay

  • Online and local multiplayer for 2 to 4 players (bring your friends!)

  • 3 distinct modes of play: regatta, gold hunt, and naval battle

  • Several maps, requiring different playstyles

  • 12 powerups, positive and negative ones

  • Simple controls - use WSAD keys, arrows, controllers, and mix it as you wish

  • Cute penguins and little boats between colourful islands

store_data.about_the_game:
As you observe the environment and interact with the enigmatic blackbird, puzzles emerge from its objects of interest. Each solution reveals another piece of the story, gradually transforming the scene into something fragile and uneasy.

What begins as a beautiful summer day slowly fades into somber, surreal autumn, revealing an emotional story of hope and sorrow.

Ignore the Blackbird is a handcrafted, narrative puzzle game. It is made to be a thoughtful experience, featuring relaxing puzzles that drive the narrative forward, where piecing together the story itself is the game's ultimate puzzle.

If you enjoy the game, please join our Discord to share your theories of what happened to Sonya and her family. We'd love to hear it!

     

  • Hand-drawn watercolor world
    Pencils and true watercolour with traditional techniques on physical paper. (We'll make a video about it when we have the time!)

  • Environmental puzzles
    Discover puzzles that grow naturally from the objects and surroundings in the room.

  • A quiet, emotional story
    Piece together the story of Sonya and the blackbird as the scene slowly changes.

  • A focused one-sitting experience
    A narrative puzzle experience that takes about an hour if played at a steady, contemplative pace.

  • The beginning of the Blackbird series
    A prelude to Sonya's big adventure.

store_data.about_the_game:
Die for the Rat King is a hand-drawn roguelike where dice-driven deckbuilding meets dungeon crawling, exploration and monster battles. 


The underground wasn't always infested with monsters. Appointed by the Rat King, you are tasked to defeat the horrors and reclaim the depths. Your arsenal of dice, rings and items might seem weak, but with the right upgrades and the smartest combos, you have a fighting chance. The Rat King will provide you some, but expecting you to fail, he is hoarding resources for his next champion. To truly survive, you’ll have to scavenge the rest from the shadows yourself.

Dice-based deck-building action

  • Forge your dice for winning strategies: Upgrade faces, pips and shapes. Can a coin be used as a die? Why not?

  • Collect and enhance rings to rewrite the rules. Need a 1 to count as a 6? With the right ring, it can.

  • Find the best synergies to win the game.

Explore the depths

  • Randomly generated dungeons packed with monsters and secrets to discover.

  • Take risks and get rewarded with upgrades, items and resources necessary to survive.

  • Make sure to explore and find all opportunities to get stronger on each floor, because it won't be any easier further down.

store_data.about_the_game:
Nyctophobia is a psychological horror experience that traps you in the quiet night shift of a roadside motel… where something feels terribly wrong.

You play as a motel receptionist working alone for three nights. Guests come and go, each with their own strange behavior, but the real danger begins when the lights go out.

Because when the darkness takes over… you’re not alone anymore.

Dialogue

Every guest has a story.

You’ll interact with different visitors, each with their own personality, behavior, and intentions.
Some seem normal… others feel off.

Security Cameras

You are always watching… but are you safe?

Monitor the motel through security cameras and keep track of what’s happening around you.

Darkness

The lights won’t stay on forever.

Power outages can happen at any moment, forcing you to leave the safety of the reception and enter dark areas to restore electricity.

But the darkness isn’t empty.

A presence follows you.
You’re not sure if it’s real… or if your mind is breaking.

store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO THE EDGE OF THE GALAXY, COMMANDER.
Deep Space Merchant is a highly addictive, pure-mechanics trading and management simulator with a retro, text-based terminal aesthetic. You are the newly appointed manager of an isolated space station. Every day brings new ships, volatile markets, and deadly risks. Your goal? Infinite profit and survival in the cold void.

Instead of relying on flashy graphics, Deep Space Merchant focuses entirely on the thrill of the deal and the satisfaction of exponential growth. Start small by trading Scrap Metal with desperate scavengers. Expand your cargo bays, scale up your operations, and soon you'll be dealing in Antimatter and Dark Matter with galactic elites. But beware—growth comes at a cost.

THE GALAXY REACTS TO YOU (ADAPTIVE AI)
No single strategy works forever. An intelligent backend system monitors your playstyle and throws unique challenges your way:

  • Anti-Hoarding: Stockpiling too much of one item? You might trigger a sudden Market Crash, plummeting its value.

  • Anti-Greed: Sitting on a mountain of credits with weak defenses? Expect a targeted inside job by ruthless mercenaries.

  • Anti-Spam: Buying too many trade ships? You might attract a massive Pirate Blockade.

MANAGE A RUTHLESS ECONOMY

  • Upkeep & Finances: A massive station isn't cheap. Every module, cargo space, and ship adds to your daily upkeep. Fall behind, and your balance drops below zero.

  • The Intergalactic Bank: Out of credits? Take out a high-interest loan from the Bank to seize a rare trading opportunity—just make sure you can pay it back before the interest swallows your profits.

BUILD YOUR ECONOMIC EMPIRE
Your credits are your greatest weapon. Use your hard-earned profits to construct powerful modules:

  • Build a Hydroponics Bay or Medical Center to sustain your passengers.

  • Install a Scanner Array to optimize trade prices, or build a Smuggler's Hideout to evade pirate patrols.

  • Expand your living quarters, build a Hotel, and upgrade your Bar into a fully operational Casino to watch the credits roll in as passengers gamble their savings away.

SURVIVE THE OUTER RIM
Space is unforgiving. As your station's wealth grows, so does the threat level. Defend against deadly pirate raids, survive sudden food spoilage, and look out for rare, once-in-a-lifetime events like discovering a derelict cruiser filled with credits.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Endless Procedural Economy: Negotiate mixed cargo bundles, manage 20 unique sci-fi commodities, and adapt to an ever-changing market.

  • Dynamic Scaling System: As your capacity grows, larger ships arrive. Upgrade costs dynamically scale, providing a balanced, endless "endgame" experience.

  • Atmospheric Terminal Interface: A beautifully minimalist, no-scroll interface. Watch the fading, dimming logs of your station's history as 200 unique ambient events create a deeply immersive "Captain's Log" atmosphere every single day.

  • Original Synth Soundtrack: Built-in atmospheric sci-fi music to keep you focused while you crunch the numbers.

No complicated tutorials. No massive downloads. Just you, your terminal, and the pursuit of endless wealth in the dark, quiet depths of space.

store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO CLIFTON ISLAND

Clifton is a beautiful tropical island in the Pacific, unknown to many and uninhabited.

YOU ARE NOT ALONE

Going on vacation to Clifton Island might seem like a great idea, but the morning after you arrive on the island, you find your tour guide murdered on the beach. Who killed her and why?

You’re supposed to be alone on the island, but it’s clear that you’re not...

RUN IF YOU CAN

On the island, along with you and your friends, there are 4 killers who will do everything in their power to take you out. They work together, but they are distinct both in appearance and in their actions: each of them, in fact, has their own well-defined characteristics that you’ll soon come to know on Clifton Island. Don’t underestimate them!

To escape, you’ll need to build a makeshift raft, and to do so, you’ll need resources like logs, rope, and much more. Clifton Island is vast, and its lush natural environment will help you gather the materials you need. But never let your guard down, because your new “best friends” are always lurking!

Chef's Dogma is a quick, but turn-based Roguelite game, primarily focused on battling and then using the rewards, events, and shops to upgrade your team. The game is planned to release with Steamdeck support, including full-controls! A run can take roughly 20-40min playtime, making it perfect for a lunch break, train ride, or relaxing at the park!

Select your Team from a Multitude of 'Foods' and 'Chefs'. Diversify, Double-Up, Triple-Up, or even Quadruple-Up to make your best Dish!




Battle your way through Apocalyptic Cities, Exotic Forests, Ancient Deserts, Fiery Volcanoes, and Depraved Dungeons until you find your Salvation.




Make your party stronger from the spoils of those vanquished, empowering your minions to decimate future foes!





Evolve two foods into 'Entrees' taking 1x Ability from each and a 3rd to form a new type of Combatant!
   



Then unlock over 50 playable characters to include 'Foods' and 'Chefs' with unique abilities and play styles, to begin your journey anew.





Core Features

  • 50 Foods to Unlock with their own types, abilities, strengths, and weaknesses.

  • 8 Chefs to Unlock with specialty combinations and their own off-turn ability usage.

  • 60+ Stat Upgrades and Effects that will empower or change how you face each fight.

  • 7 forsaken locations to traverse through, see the delusions of an unwell mind.

  • Compete in the "Chef's Challenge" leader-board, taking a randomized team through a sequential gauntlet of all levels.

  • Meta progression to soothe the Permadeath and Roguelike mechanics to make every run feel impactful.

store_data.about_the_game:
[Developer's Words] Every battle here is a contest of wits. With 17 vivid characters and 31 meticulously designed levels, we invite you to relive the pure charm of classic tactical RPGs.

[Background] Set on an otherworldly continent ruled by the Magic Dragon Empire, where corrupt elites tyrannize the land and enslave its people. To revolt against this dark reign, a group of passionate youths formed the "ReconBraves." Through countless perils, these 17 core members unite to defy the evil forces led by Prime Minister Ramos, writing a heroic epic of their own.

[Game Features]

  • Classic Tactical Gameplay: This Game is A single-player SRPG built, focusing on strategic layout and character development.

  • Rich Level Challenges: A total of 31 stages take you step-by-step on a crusade against the Empire.

  • Diverse Growth: 17 cultivable characters across various classes like Tactician, War Lord, and Shadow Slash.

  • Attribute Progression: With a level cap of 40, eight core stats—including HP, ATK, Skill, and Agility—grow precisely as you level up.

  • Deep Equipment System: Features 7 weapon types (Sword, Spear, Axe, Bow, Staff, Dagger, Gauntlet) and a full gear system including Armor, Helmets, and Accessories.

  • Unique Combat Mechanics: Realistic hit rate formulas, defense modifiers, and critical hit checks make every move unpredictable.

  • Strategic Tactical Actions: Beyond attacking, use commands like Guard (halve damage) or Rest (restore HP/MP). Master the "no-cost" equipment swapping strategy to counter tough foes.

  • Progressive Shop Updates: Nine tiers of shops unlock increasingly powerful "Black Gold" legendary gear as you progress.

  • Counter-attack & Resupply: Trigger counters within range; leveling up automatically refills HP and Energy to keep the battle tempo high.

[Pro Tips]

  • Leveling Strategy: Healing, buffing, and non-lethal attacks all grant a portion of EXP. Balanced distribution is key to victory.

  • Supply Prep: Shops offer recovery potions from Small to Extra Large, along with "Emergency Action Potions" for extra turns and "Short-range Teleport Scrolls."

  • Gear Choice: Pay attention to weapon traits—for instance, the "Black Gold Axe" ignores 30% of target defense when attacking without moving.
